Had I not seen some of the souvenirs at the museum (there are at least three, so if you regret not buying something right after, you will get another chance no worries), I would have missed the frescoes that are there (In my opinion, less or equal impressive than the ones in the Sistine chapel).

The perfect Vatican City tour! Our guide Giuliano gave us so many interesting information about St. Peter's Basilica, the museums as well as the Sistine Chapel. Even if the starting time seems early, it's ideal since the Vatican tents to get really crowded later.
Not even one moment was boring and I wouldn't have been able to enjoy the Vatican and actually learn all these things without a guided tour. 100% recommend, you won't regret it!

The guide was friendly and knowledgeable but the group size was too big and it was so crowded some people were starting to freak out.

Too much time spent outside in the hot sun and guide was so scared of losing people we were not allowed to stand in the shade.

If you get anxious in big crowds this tour is not for you.

We had a wonderful experience in Vatican and it was all due this wonderful tour and our amazing guide Marco. Marco was very informative and also provide interesting stories about the artists, popes and wonderful cities of Italy. Highly recommend this tour if you are in the area!

The tour was very interesring, entertaining and efficient. Within three hours we were shown the absolute highlights of the Vatican city and told lots of details and stories.
After that we had the opportunity to stay in the Vatican Museum - there would be another few hours worth of discovering things, for those who aren’t exhausted yet 👍🏼
Bring a bottle of water.

What a wonderful tour! Not only was the team super communicative the days before the tour with specific instructions and weather updates, but they were also very responsive with questions I asked. Once the tour started (we had Lucia as a guide) - she did a great job trying to get to know us and of keeping the group on schedule and answered every single question the group had. I can’t recommend this tour enough.

We had a great experience on this tour with Gabriel! There is so much to see throughout the tour, it can be overwhelming but Gabriel did an excellent job of showcasing the most important areas to look at. He was very knowledgeable and it was great to have no wait to get into the Vatican. In a crowded setting he did a good job of pointing out the sites, making sure we could hear him and keeping the group moving. Would definitely recommend this tour!

Great tour, amazing tour guide (Julien). Three and a half hours of amazing sights, history, facts and fun.
We navigated the St Peter’s Basilica, Vatican Museums and Sistine Chapel with about 40 people. The presentation of all the major works was fascinating and done in a concise and interesting fashion (hats off to Julien).
In addition, there were about 20% of the normal tourists, due to the pandemic, so we breezed through with very few disruptions.
If you plan on visiting the Vatican, do this tour, you’ll be as satisfied as we were!

First and foremost - our guide Marco was incredible. He was passionate, funny, knowledgeable and really made the tour and location come to life. Great knowledge of dates which he used in a way that drew a picture of how St Peter’s was built, by who and how the various influences of the day impacted it. Highly recommend.

This was a great tour. Small group. Very much worth the time. You were moving pretty quickly to get to the next exhibition but he took time at each one to make sure you could look and compare the perspective the artists put in. Like a table that always points toward you from left or tight of the artwork. Thank you.

This 3 1/2 hour tour of the Vatican was informative, professional and provided a great introduction to the Vatican City. Our guide, Giuliano, was very well informed and offered interesting side bits of information and trivia. He kept the tour flowing well to cover everything but never made us feel rushed. He also offered some general travel tips at the end of the tour. With the crowds low- it was a great time for us to visit. Thanks Giuliano!

Upon entering St Peter's, my reaction was "just wow". Lucia was a great guide and we very much enjoyed our St Peter's tour with her. Lucia's positive attitude, knowledge and English were first rate. She was our favorite guide of several in our 2 week Italian tour. Inspired, we returned the next day to access the dome on our own.

Notes for future travelers: This tour does have some time outdoors that can be very hot (entry lines and a 10 min synopsis of Sistine Chapel paintings). Also note that time in the Vatican museums is minimal with the guide but you are free to explore afterwards.

This was a great tour with a fabulous guide. Like all these tours, you're skipping the 'no ticket' line but there's still a fair bit of queueing to get through the security, get tickets and get radios and this is a bit tedious. Once through though, you are overwhelmed by the sheer size, beauty and history. Our guide (sorry I didn't get her name) was wonderful, giving all the key historical information but also lots of other fascinating titbits. The tour is around 3 hours but you can stay in the basillica longer if you want to explore and even climb the dome.

Our tour guide, Valerie, was extremely knowledgeable and despite the crowds, was able to show us so much! She kept a quick pace walking from one place to another which was a challenge for our particular party. I am not sure if there is an alternate option for elderly and handicapped. I would recommend anyone booking this tour with special needs do more research for options or reconsider this particular tour. Still, the tour itself was fantastic!

Chiara from Made in Rome tours was an amazing guide for our tour! She was so full of energy, full of little jokes, and had a wealth of knowledge about everything we toured. She was very engaging and personable, and made this tour a highlight of our trip. We toured St Peter's Basilica first, then made our way around the Vatican walls to the Vatican museum - in total we walked around for 4 hours start to finish. There weren't very many lines to skip at the moment, due to Covid, but having a guide was definitely worth the money. Highly recommend this tour, and a big thank you to Chiara for making it even better!

We booked this trip prior to traveling out to Rome, was really easy and the communication was great. We arrived at the meeting point and was introduced to our guide Lucia, she was lovely and made an effort to introduce herself to each of us individually, she then throughout the trip remembered all of our names and did checks in with each of us - this for me really made a difference to the experience. We were most definitely wowed by the trip and what we saw. She made connectios tonwhqtbww say really enhancing our understanding of things. Lucia was so knowledgeable and we came away really feeling like we had learnt things. At the end of the tour she also directed us to other things in the Vatican city that would boost our experience- as a result we went back into the Basilica and down to the Vatican Toombes.
We would definitely recommend this tour!! And if you get Lucia as your guide it's a bonus!

Our guide, Marco Genna, was super knowledgeable and friendly. The tour was well organized and we learned a lot, not just about the Vatican Museum, St Peter’s Basilica, and the Sistene Chapel, but also about more general and even useful things, like how to properly drink out of Rome’s many potable water fountains. Bravo! There were some unusual things that happened, like a false bomb scare, and Marco handled the situation professionally. Next time I am in Rome I will book more tours with this company.

Really enjoyed this tour. Tour was early enough to enjoy a relatively quiet St Peter’s square. Our guide (Rob) was very knowledgable and easy to listen to. Shuffling through the Vatican museum was a bit uncomfortable due to the amount of people - wouldn’t like to do this in the height of the Summer.

This was our favorite tour while in Rome. We would have been lost trying to see the Vatican and St. Peter’s Basilica on our own! I wish we could recall our guides name (British man) as he was absolutely amazing! He was so knowledgeable and thorough on our tour, we truly appreciated how much studying and time from his life he must have put into knowing the Vatican museums, the sistine chapel and St. Peter’s Basilica - it was amazing how much information he was able to provide to us. He took the time to answer everyone’s questions. There was so much to see and take in but I truly believe he pointed out the best things for us to observe on our tour. Would highly recommend to anyone!

We booked this tour through trip advise for the 4 of us.
The meeting point was easy to find and the group size was quite small. We met out guide Elaine and began the short walk to St Peter's.
Once inside Elaine gave us many fascinating facts about all the statues and the scale of the Basilica.
We then had another short walk to the museum, where once again we never queued for long and were guided around the museum given loads of great facts. The museum is so vast that days could be spent inside looking at everything if that is your thing.
Elaine showed us the highlights and we felt that we had seen plenty.
Finally the Sistine chapel. Elaine explained the pictures before we entered, this was a great help in understanding the history of this amazing place.
Well worth booking if you find yourself in Rome.
Radios were provided throughout the tour to make sure you can here all that is being said.
Definitely worth taking a guided tour, so much information is given that otherwise you wouldn't know.

Every city we visit we always book on to a local tour guide. Giuliano was the best guide we have ever had. He is so knowledgeable, friendly, genuine and just marvellous. I cannot recommend this company more highly. A very well organised and truly excellent tour. Giuliano's passion really makes it something special which matters so much when visiting this historical place. Absolutely first class.

At the beginning we were greeted, right after split into groups of 20 participants. Chiara from Made in Rome Tours was a very informative, funny and also (at least from my perspective) the most thorough guide of the bunch. We've made a lot of stops where she shined with her knowledge, it was exceptionally interesting and very funny too. The little jokes she made, helped me to stay focused and it also kept a nice homy atmosphere. Private questions about good restaurants and other things to check out in the city were also kindly answered.
To be honest, at least for me, it was one of my favourite tours I took in my life and I don't regret any penny spent. Rome is a beautiful city, but touring around with Chiara was a pleasure in itself!
If U read this thank U again :)

This was a great tour for anyone interested in seeing St. Peter’s Basilica, the Vatican and Sistine Chapel. The tour was very informative and well organized. Our guide (Giuliano) was very knowledgeable and delivered a lot of information in a way that was easy to understand. I would do this tour again if I return to Rome.

Our tour guide was great! I really appreciate how much he truly cared about the Vatican, it’s stories, and it’s history. It was easily able to be displayed by how much he had the want and need to tell us everything and every little minor detail. The only reason I did not give it 5/5 is because it became very tiresome. Too long of a time standing on your feet. Not given time to sit down and rest. I’m 29 years old, and remain relatively active, so normally i wouldn’t have a problem. However, i can be on my feet for longer periods of time, so long as I’m walking and moving. Standing in place is difficult for me for long periods of time. That’s where the main issue was. Perhaps if the tour guide was able to walk and talk at the same time, then i wouldn’t have had such an issue. But everytime he wanted to talk, he had to stop. Additionally, there’s really no place to get water, so make sure you bring a water bottle with you to the tour. You will need it! I was parched by the end of the 4.5 hr tour. I speed-walked to the cafeteria to get 2 bottles of water and a Fanta to get my blood sugar back up!

Very good guide, Giuliano. Enthusiastic, knowledgeable, and mindful of his clients. But…there are just too many people in the Vatican Museum and Sistine Chapel to make the experience anything more than (barely) tolerable. It’s like being a sardine in a very large, very crowded can. Hard to appreciate the magnificent artwork surrounding you. My advice: come in late Fall or early Spring.

First day with new covid requirements and it all went smoothly. Our very experienced and knowledgeable tour guide, Julian, gave an exceptional tour of the Vatican, Sistine Chapel & St. Peter's Basilica with many insights, and in depth information of the works, history and artists of the time. He even helped with taking fantastic photos. Highly recommended

having skip the line included was vital. being able to walk straight into the sights made the tour worth every penny before you even consider all the knowledge our guide had. we loved it and learnt so much about the history of the Vatican.

Breathtaking tour of St Peter’s Basilica followed by highlights of the Vatican museum and time in the Sistine Chapel. Our tour guide was Marco, who was full of knowledge and enthusiasm and was keen to share it with the group. His explanation of the paintings in the Sistine Chapel made the visit much more enjoyable. He shepherded us round with care and attention and made the whole experience great. Highly recommended.

Best Tour We've Had In Italy after 2 trips.
The tour operator gave perfect instructions that were clear. They delivered on each thing we were told to expect and our tour guide was very personable and filled with knowledge about St. Peters, the Sistine Chapel, and the Vatican.I would HIGHLY encourage you to use this tour operator for your trip.

Our tour guide, Frank from Belgium, was incredibly passionate about the masterpieces in display. He gave us great insight into the history while keeping the tour entertaining with a great sense of humor. We even got to see exhibitions generally ignored by other tours, truly a unique experience.

Brilliant tour - our guide was extremely well informed and went above and beyond to make every member of the group feel welcome. So worth the money and a great last minute purchase when every other ticket for the vatican was unavailable. Thank you for the food recommendations as well - they were extremely helpful. Overall would definitely recommend.

The tour covered many highlights in the Vatican. It was a lot of walking but the tour guide kept us in the shade and did as much as possible to expediate the process of green pass/security. The guide was knowledgeable and helpful. Overall, a good tour with a lot of information ... was helpful in understanding the importance of certain artworks and having more context to understand the history.

Marko was an amazing guide and his wealth of knowledge is incredible. It felt a little rushed going through the Vatican Museum but I’m sure you could spend a full day in there and still not have covered everything!! Enjoyed that we covered both the Vatican and St Peter’s Basilica. Price very reasonable compared to other companies but the group sizes are quite large (30 people). Wearing headsets makes sure everyone can hear the commentary. Would recommend.

We did a tour of the Vatican, Sistine Chapel and St Peter's Basilica lead by Guiliano who was an excellent guide and provided an interesting and insightful commentary. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone who would like to see the highlights of these places within a few hours. The tour kept my 11 year old son entertained and engaged which was quite an achievement!

We had a fascinating tour of St. Peter’s Basilica, the Vatican Museum, and the Sistine Chapel. Our tour guide, Norman, was excellent: very knowledgeable and a pleasure to spend the morning with. There’s so much to take in when visiting Vatican City, it’s very helpful to have a guide drawing your eye to particular artifacts and to provide more history. Highly recommended!

A fantastic tour! Our tour guide was amazing and we felt like we got the full Vatican City experience with so much great information. It was also quite early in the morning which meant we missed all of the long security queues. Would highly recommend this to anyone wanting to visit Vatican City! 5 stars.

At the Vatican, my boyfriend and I had an incredible time. The meeting point was easy to find, the groups were well organised, and our guide (Marco) enhanced the experience with his knowledge of the Vatican City. I would without a doubt recommend this tour to anyone visiting the Vatican for the first time.

Great and informative, there is a lot of walking so wear comfy shoes. It’s better to go in the morning as It gets very crowded later in the day. Tour group was big so we didn’t feel rushed to keep up with the group.

Loved our tour with Julienne (or Guillien). We had a large group and he was very adept at keeping us together and at speaking loudly and clearly. He has a great knowledge of history and very accommodating of questions. A great guy too! Definitely would recommend his tour!

The guide was very nice and knowledgeable. Only bad part of the tour was the group size. 30 people is way too large for a tour. The guide had to constantly check that everyone was still with us! If you’re a party of 2-4 people better off booking a private tour.

The arrangements were excellent. From check in, to group assignment, radio issue. Our guide was Paola. She took us along at a good pace, was very knowledgeable and informative, and managed the group through the large crowds very well. She was considerate to the older, more infirm guests, seeking shade and controlling the pace and checking out for them regularly. I would thoroughly recommend this tour, especially for the first time visitor to Rome.

Giulliano was our tour guide for the day and he was super informative, friendly and really considerate to everyone in the group as the age range and ability was very varied. At the starting point he went through the whole Sistine chapel so we knew what we were looking at once we got there, which as I’ve visited the Vatican before gave me a whole different outlook looking at it. He knew everything when questioned and just gave little insights that I feel most guides would not have known. Giulliano clearly loves the Vatican and his job and this comes across in all he says. The skipping the line was well worth it as the queue for St. Peter’s basilica was extremely long all day the tour jumped all of this. Would definitely recommend this tour and especially giulliano and the Vatican and all it holds is breathtaking!!!

Fantastic tour, booked this through trip advisor prior to visiting Rome and so glad we did. Stumbled across the Vatican City the day before when wandering around and the queues were huge. This got us straight in 'through the backdoor' and lots of quick access routes through the tour particularly to get you quick access to the sistine chapel. A short delay to get the headsets sorted but it was a welcome 5 minute toilet break. Our tour guide Guiliano was very knowledgeable with very good English and made the tour humorous and entertaining, this has to be the best money we spent in Rome. Book it you'll love it !!!

Visiting those amazing historical sights with Giuliano was a delightful experience. We learnt a lot of interesting historical facts and Giuliano was the best guide we could wish for (and this is coming from someone who has been on a lot of tours). The best part was definitely the Sistine Chapel but the whole tour was informative, engaging & immersive. We definitely recommend the company & can't wait to go on another tour with them!

Glad we decided to skip the line as we went on New Year’s Eve and the line into the Vatican was five to six hours long. There was about a 20 minute walk to the Vatican and then about a 20 minute security line wait.

Since there is no talking within the Sistine Chapel Giuliano gave the run down of the paintings outside the tour office. This ended up saving us time since we didn’t have to wait in line within the Vatican to hear the description.

We got our headsets once in the Vatican Museum. Giuliano did a great job explaining the history and meaning of all the art we walked past and he was easy to understand through the headset. He also did a great job of wrangling us and keeping us together among a huge mass of other visitors.

Very grateful to Giuliano and this tour for helping us to see the sights while on a short time budget.

We started our tour at 8.45 with our guide explaining that it would be a three hour tour. I completely get that the line just to get through security was nearly an hour. No one can skip this queue. Then we had to wait for our earpiece things. Then we got in to St. Peter’s which was beautiful and learned some very interesting things. Then we went into the Vatican museum - we could skip the line here as there was some people queuing for tickets. But it was really getting on now and it was around midday and three hours in. At 12.30 in the Vatican museum, the guide says there’ll be 3 more hours!!!! At that point we hadn’t seen anything but the Roman sculpture. We handed our headsets back to the guide. The kids were exhausted and hungry. We marched through the rest of the Vatican museums pausing for the Raphael rooms and the Sistine chapel.
If you go on this tour you will need to bring your lunch and possibly your dinner too, and litres of water. The guide was pleasant and knowledgeable but it was just too long.

This tour was an event I was really forward to. The idea of knowing that I was going to be standing in the Sistine Chapel was a once in a life time moment! The only reason I could not give the review five stars was the fact it was very difficult to understand our guide. I know this was primarily due to the fact that he was required to wear a mask throughout the tour. So, given the natural background noise that comes from other tour groups and being masked I was not always able to hear our guide. I feel like having ear buds as we did in our other tours would have helped a lot.

You MUST book a skip the line tour - otherwise you will wait all day in a line and not have the knowledge of what you see.
Would be great if the tour was another half an hour to see a bit more of St Peter’s Basilica.
Filipe was a magnificent tour guide and very compassionate about anyone with mobility issues.

If I could have rated this tour 6 stars I would have. Of all the tours I’ve done across Europe, I have never had a tour guide as knowledgeable and well organized as Giuliano. The tour lasted 3.5 hours, but I could have listened to Giuliano speak for two full days. The level of education he has about what you’re seeing is fantastic, and I left feeling I could have done it all again. Will recommend to any friends and family I know traveling to the Vatican in the future.

Tour did not happen. When I called at the starting hour, phone was answered and I was told the guide could not make it for personal reasons. Another guide would be there one hour later. Nobody showed up and the phone was never answered.

Family of 4 booked the tour and staff at the office were extremely helpful in accommodating us given we had booked for the following day when we were at rugby.
Our guide Giuliano was superb from start to finish, he didn’t have the stick with flag/scarf he took time to greet each and every one of us individually and remembered who we throughout.
We are not religious in any way, but the history of the Vatican provided by Giuliano was in depth and insightful.
Would 100% recommend the company to everyone.

We booked our tour guide for Vatican City through ‘viatour’ which we got an amazing tour guide, ear piece and skip the lines. Our tour guide was amazing and really knew her stuff, her name was Claire. She always got you involved and asked questions making it more fun for us while walking round. We visited all the art and sculpture galleries, which then led us the the Sistine chapel which you aren’t aloud to talk in or take pictures which we were fine with as it is honestly eye-opening and breathtaking. Vatican City is just amazing. Highly recommend anyone to go and book this excursion through ‘viatour’ or on here for made in Rome tours. If I visit Rome again which i probably will I’d go to Vatican City again 100%!

Michael was the perfect tour guide. He clearly has a passion for his subject, is extremely knowledgeable, conveys his knowledge with flair and enough levity to keep us smiling and alert. He was calm and friendly and perfectly judged what could be absorged by the group in three hours. Highly recommended!

Our tour of the Vatican and Sistine Chapel with Marco was AMAZING! Marco was kind, incredibly knowledgeable, and engaging of our entire family - adults, 2 teenagers, and even our toddler. I would also encourage anyone that is able to consider this tour now, while the crowds are still few post-COVID. We nearly had the place to ourselves allowing time to truly enjoy up close incredible works of art!

Excellent tour. We had Bob as our guide, he was knowledgeable and interesting and of course seeing Saint Peter’s and the Sistine Chapel is completely wonderful. We wouldn’t have enjoyed the sights half so much without the tour though, totally recommend.

St Peter's was fantastic. No crowds! The size of the building and the amount of history were just amazing. Julian's commentary of the various pieces of art, interesting points, and facts just added more to the experience. The best part of the trip to Rome.

Took this tour 4th January 2020 when it was still really busy after the New Year. The queue for the Vatican was very very long so Skip the Line was a great way to save time.
Our guide Guiliano was friendly and very enthusiastic and full of very interesting facts about the things we were seeing.
I Would recommend this tour.
Be aware you have to be patient as entry to the Vatican involves security checks and some unavoidable delays but Skip the line meant Guiliano got us inside as quickly as he could and ensured that time spent passing through these check was kept to a minimum
Great tour. Thank you

Marco was a very informative and funny guide! His personality made the tour very enjoyable! Other tour guides can be informative but very dry, like a school lecture. But Marco made it entertaining, interesting, and we all learned a lot! The tour ends inside the Vatican Museum, so you can take your time browsing the rest of the gigantic museums within a museum at your own pace. 100% recommend!

The money for skipping the line was so worth it. There were hundreds of people waiting on a massive line to gain entrance. We walked right in. Our guide, Norman, was a wealth of knowledge and was open to questions.
A few tips: wear comfortable shoes, there is a lot of walking. Hydrate. Dress appropriately, you will be entering into cathedral areas. You cannot take pictures in the Sistine Chapel and they mean it.
Overall, a wonderful experience.

we did the tour with Juliano last week while in rome and it was amazing. Easy to find the meet up office before tour. Juliano was super friendly and energetic, we both came away filled with knowledge from the breath taking museum & the Sistine chapel, if you are coming to the Vatican city i'd highly recommend booking this tour

This was probably the best tour guide we had in Italy. I can’t recall his name but he was 35-40, has 2 kids, beard and short ponytail. His picture is here, but I highly recommend doing whatever you can to get him. He was satirical and knowledgeable. I was captivated the entire time and walked away with a ton of information that I’ll actually remember. Thank you so much for the tour and the experience. My only recommendation is to do the tomb part last because it leads you out of the basilica and there was no way back in that we could find easily. The tour guide leaves you in the basilica at the end of the tour and we didn’t realize that.

The tour was absolutely AMAZING! My friend and I visited Rome for four days end of May 2021. We booked Vatican tour with Giuliano and it was very best decision. Giuliano is a great storyteller and really passionate and knowledgeable about the history. He created very comfortable and nice atmosphere and made the whole tour a memorable experience! It is amazing how he knows so many details and can capture the attention during the whole tour. On the next day we booked also Colosseum tour - It really makes a difference to go through the attractions on your own or be guided by the one who can give unique details and stories. It is a 100% recommendation !

What an excellent tour, thanks to our guide Marco. The process to book the tour was super easy. We were given great directions to reach the meeting point. The host was very pleasant and check in was a breeze. We were broken down in small groups based on the tour we had paid for. Then we were handed off to Marco. From the onset, he was very pleasant and engaging. He had funny anecdotes and showed us hidden spots during the entire tour. So happy to have booked this tour. Thank you Marco for a wonderful tour.

Guiliano was great from start to finish. Despite an original booking error they were able to reschedule for us and consistently make us feel comfortable. On the tour Guiliano was incredibly knowledgeable and enthusiastic as a tour guide explaining a vast number of different points I am sure we would have missed by ourselves. It makes such a huge difference having the tour at 9am rather than later in the day as the whole of the Vatican is much quieter, it makes it much easier to see all the key parts. Would highly recommend this tour to anyone interested in visiting Rome or Vatican City.

My partner and I did this tour in January and we both agree it was excellent and worth every cent! It was very well-organised with clear instructions on the meeting point and what to expect. Our guide Giuliano was fantastic and really made the tour. He was extremely knowledgeable and his ten years experience really showed as he provided comprehensive context and information throughout the entire tour. My partner and I both enjoyed that the tour was completely stress-free as our guide took care of everything, including all entry points and explained how to navigate the Vatican Museum, Sistine Chapel, and Saint Peter's Basilica. The guide also clearly knew the staff as he was able to provide access and entry at points that other groups could not. The tour can feel rushed, but this is necessary to keep up with the pace of how all tourists and groups are going through the areas. Guiliano did a great job of keeping everyone together and making sure we were all comfortable with the pace and tour. We would highly recommend this tour!

Our tour guide was Marco, and he was fantastic! He was personable and very knowledgeable. He made the tour smooth and engaging. St. Peter’s Basilica was closed the day we visited, so we didn’t get to see it as part of our tour, but Marco still shared so much knowledge about the basilica and the square so we’d have some information if we were able to visit at a later time. And even without touring St. Peter’s, we definitely feel like we got our money’s worth and more! The whole operation ran smoothly and we had a great time.

Our experience with Chiara was exceptional, touring St Peter’s Basilica, the Vatican Museums and Sistine Chapel. With a smile on her face, jokes throughout the tour, she made the experience more lively and fascinating. Appreciate the fact that every step of the tour was presented with an explained and detailed presentation. Thank you Chiara 😊

Marco was our guide & he was Excellent! As we passed the line of people waiting 2 hours just to get their tickets, I was thankful I paid for "skip-the-line". There were 29 in our group. I had the honor of visiting Vatican City on Good Friday which made it even more special.

Tour guides were so knowledgeable and very very friendly. Tickets were very affordable compared to other companies also. Best decision I made when planning out my trip to Rome!! Glad I had someone to bring me to the highlights in the Vatican museum because if I remember facts from yesterday: there are 1200 rooms and if you wanted to see every item in the museum for 1 minute each then you would have to spend 14.5 years doing so. Get your ticket to avoid this!

I would recommend this tour. It was helpful to skip the line, but also to learn the details of the location that I wouldn't have known. There were several secret details to the art and architecture of the buildings we went to. I felt like we were given enough time in each location to look at everything. If you want to learn about the Vatican, this is the one.

Fabulous guide in Guliano who had so much energy and enthusiasm for his work. It was funny at the start he went around the group (15-20 of us) and shook everyone’s hand, with the Coronavirus on the rise people promptly bought out their hand sanitiser - it was quite funny. The tour was incredible, and skipping the line is the only way to go, a little bit of walking but very manageable. Security was seemless and quick. Guilano’s explanation and overview of art and different parts of the Vatican was exceptional, he guided us through various parts allowing time at the key and important parts of the tour. The meeting point was easy to find and co-ordination /logistics easy.

Lucia was an outstanding guide. Her knowledge and clear explanations helped us to understand and better appreciate the skills and dedication of the artists. It was all delivered in an interesting and engaging manner.
She also gave us great practical advice so that we could make the most of the opportunities to revisit things we wanted to spend more time on. Worth every penny!

My wife and I are not religious at all. We still had a great time seeing all the art and history. The place was extremely crowded. They really should put a limit on how many tourists can be in the Vatican at once. That aside our tour guide was very good at getting us to where we needed to be. At some points I feel we were like herding cats. He kept having to go get people who would wander off to take pictures or simply wouldn't listen to instructions. Over all it was a great experience

This tour was an absolute triumph and I must heap praise on our guide, Marco, for his energy, passion and care. Communication and instructions pre-tour were excellent and most helpful. I was very clear as to where and when to meet and all Covid requirements. Marco managed, with great real passion and humour, to take us through an enormous amount of history on our journey and the entire experience was a highlight of my trip to Rome. Bravo, Skip-the-line tours! Bravo, Marco! Shuna Snow, London

The Vatican City was on my bucket list and I’m so happy that I booked a tour for this. Marco brought the history to life! I felt like I was in school and am actually enjoying it. Visiting the St Peter’s square, the St Peter’s basilica, Vatican museums and the Sistine Chapel, I was in awe!
I would recommend reading Dan Brown’s books or watching the movies, just to understand a bit more of the history, iconography & the mystery behind the Vatican. To see it all in reality, it was dream come true!

Enjoyed the experience but think it is too much to see in the timeframe and is, in general, rushed. I would suggest seeing St Peter's on it's own and, if possible, the Sistine Chapel. The trip through the Vatican museum is too fast and just gives you a general idea of the treasures they have.

Excellent tour and I would highly recommend you do it! Amazing experience, great tour and fantastic experience from Bob our tour guide. He was extremely informative and told us things we would have otherwise missed if we were there alone. I would definitely do this tour again if I were to come back to Rome.
Thank you for a great day!

Giuliano was such an informative and engaging guide! He made the experience so great. We also were so lucky to go during October 2021 when there were hardly any crowds! We were able to spend more time / get up close to the sights along the tour. Highly recommend it - made my experience of the Vatican unforgettable

This is fantastic value for money. Whilst everyone else is queuing for hours we got right into the history and art treasures of the Vatican with our guide Santi. He was super with the children and quickly established a brilliant repartie with his group. It was lovely to hear him talk about the artistic treasures in the museum and the Sistine Chapel. We learned a lot and had a super time.

Loved the tour! Chiara, our guide, was amazing! She was very fun and gave very individual attention to every person on the tour. She also made everything we saw more interesting. Completely exceeded our expectations. 100% recommended.

Excellent tour, the line was very long, but we got in right away. We started the tour by going to the Vatican museum, with a lot of explanations and history, you learned a lot (I forgot the name of the tourist woman) but she was very knowledgeable. Then inside to the Sistine chapel, then inside to the Cathedral-Vatican, with more information. Totally worth it.

Great chance to see and learn about the Vatican City. Tour guide was a true subject matter expert and answered all the questions that were threw at him. I definitely recommend spending a few extra bucks to skip the line as "the line" of people was in the 100's easily,!

Great experience to see all of the good stuff, and definitely skip the line access. Gabriel was very informative and spoke excellent English, as an Art History student it was clear he was passionate and loved what he did. Recommended!

Laura our guide was excellent. The tour was extremely well organized and I would certainly recommend to anyone wanting a 3 hour full experience. Crowds were extremely large yesterday due to timing or Easter but Laura navigated and managed our your calmly and successfully for the full experience. Thank you!

Lucia was our guide for our tour of Vatican City. I recommend to check in early and leave on the earliest tour group possible. There were many. The queue in to St Peters Basilica grew very long very quickly. Lucia was all over this and made sure our wait time was kept to a minimum. Lucia was highly informative and interested, making a point to memorise all attendees and their home country. Her vast knowledge of the Basilica and Museum exhibits made for an enlightening tour. In a moment of misplaced focus l was disconnected from my tour group. I had given up all hope of finding them and went to climb St Peters Dom instead. Lo and behold, l was pleasantly surprised to receive messages and phone calls from the tour organiser who personally arranged for me to be reconnected with the group at the museum. I was so appreciative of this excellent customer service and attention to the individual, despite the high number of people who do this tour every day. This earns a 5 Star Review alone! The museum is a must see. A literal treasure trove of historic art and sensory wonders!

Tip: a small bar around the corner is an excellent place for breakfast.

The tour guide was gracious and professional. She had obviously practiced the tour a thousand times because both the process and the information was very fluid and she performed with the style and charm of a charismatic teacher. I have learned a lot and I would definitely take another tour with this company and my family and I are grateful for such a superb 3 hours.

Giuliano was the best! He was very knowledgeable, engaged, and personable. He gave the group plenty of time to look around each area and informed us of the option to stay in the museum if we cared to after the formal tour was over. It helped that the crowds were minimal, however, he did a great job of getting us as close to the highlights as possible so we could take some great photos. Great job!

The tour itself may have been good, ours was not The Basilica does not have a skip the line. We were 9:45 group 13 I would pick another time as that was its height Our guide rushed us through perfect picture opportunities telling us we can just walk back later and look and take pictures. Her interest was avoiding other groups, speeding by and stopping only at artifacts like vases
The Sistine chapel was a disaster. Inside we have read and we’re told we have 15 minutes. She got us in and out in under 5 minutes. Only then did we learn you cannot go back in. She rushed us to the end of the tour.
As I said, the tour may have been good if we had done like the other groups and paused for pictures and and certainly spent 15 minutes inside one of the worlds most well known things in the world

We found our tour guide Marco knowledgable and he took time to explain the history of the museum. As a catholic I found this trip moving and emotional. My only criticism is of other people trying to take photos in the Sistine Chapel. Most did show respect but the odd number didn’t. Would recommend getting a tour guide for this trip.

Excellent tour yesterday morning with Giuliano. Well worth the money as you get to explore all three areas and the tour itself was really informative. Would definitely recommend the skip the line. Thanks again.

Covers a lot of ground really fast. Brisk walk, lots of stairs. Do it to say you saw the stuff but don't expect to linger anywhere. Be prepared for perpetual crowds. Late afternoon bookings are the best time in summertime.

The tour was well organised and the guide was excellent and knowledgeable. The Vatican City was really busy for the time of our tour but she handled that great, making sure all the relevant info and sights were seen. We would recommend this tour to others.

A sensory overload. Super busy with what felt like hundreds of groups starting on the 9am tour at the same time. Our tour guide talked very fast at us over an earphone system, not leaving a single moment of silence for us to enjoy what were supposed to be awe inspiring sights, and failed to impart what I think was the basic relevant historical information. There was no time for us to introduce ourselves or even ask questions. The vatican staff themselves were also very rude, one lady accidentally took a photo in a photo free area and he wouldn't stop having a go at her despite her apologising several times and telling him she didn't realise. Overall a very disappointing experience of something I have waited almost my whole life to visit.

Justin provided a great narration for our 2 1/2 hour of the Vatican museum and Sistine Chapel. He provided a fascinating amount of background about the artists and politics of the past. I would recommend trying to get him if possible.

Good tour, very informative. St. Basilica was amazing. I guess under the circumstances you could say it was skip the line but to be clear, there are still lines to stand in and waiting around that will happen. Wish we had more time at the church for sure & the opportunity to go to the top for those who were interested. Having the guide was great - I definitely learned a lot in the Vatican Museums. It was a tonnnn of walking. By the time we reached the Sistine Chapel my lower half was on fire so I didn't stay as long as I'd originally planned. Wear great shoes!

Exceptional guide. Problems with hearing the audio caused by guide radio in pocket otherwise she was extremely knowledgable and friendly. Skip the queue is a must as the queues are horrendous otherwise, and the guide navigated the crowds expertly. Highly recommended

Excellent, organized tour. Our tour guide was Christian Savona. He was extremely knowledgeable and engaging. He made sure to point out important details along with fun finds. He was very kind and bought me a bottle of water because I didn’t have small bills for the vending machine (he repeated this gesture for others in the group as well). Definitely recommend this tour!

Excellent tour with Marco. His knowledge and way of imparting knowledge to an English speaking group was spot on. We were a group of 24 which was a bit larger than we were expecting but wasn’t a problem with such a good guide and whilst things are generally still quiet. If Rome was busier it may have been a problem. Made in Rome Tours were really helpful and accommodating whilst I made our booking and I have no hesitation recommending them.

Felt like it was quite overpriced, given that admissions tickets were not necessary at several places. Guide was informative when in the Basilica or museum, but in all the time walking or waiting in line he did not talk unless someone asked a question. I felt like there could have been a lot more information shared and context given!

Marco was a very caring and knowledgeable tour guide. He always waited for me to catch up to the group (walking difficulty) or gave us the meeting point, so we could meet back with the group. I appreciated his kindness. He was very knowledgeable and shared many facts that helped us understand the development of the art and how difficult it was for the artists.

Thank you Marco!

Highly recommend, especially if you want a focused version of the Vatican and all it entails. The Vatican and all it entails is massive, so it helps to be able to hit the highlights to understand what you’re looking at. Marco our guide made the experience visiting St. Peter’s, the Vatican and Sistine chapel very memorable. It was very interesting to learn about the details pertaining to the history of everything involved. We never would have known what these meant or what the artist meant with out his knowledge! Without Marco we would have been fumbling around and admiring what we were looking at, but would not understanding any of it. Thank you Marco!!

Giuliano was the BEST! Knowledgeable, enthusiastic, and he made sure we saw all the highlights! His commentary was interesting and informative, and it really brought the art to life. He would help take pictures of couples and families and was incredibly helpful and kind. Book this tour and cross your fingers you get Guliano as a guide!

What can I say . We were blown away with this tour.

Norman you are an outstanding guide, your knowledge and interesting talks were fantastic and very knowledgeable. It simply made the tour for me with the insights you shared.

The tour starts about a 10 minute walk from the Vatican city. The Bascilica does not have a skip the line no one is more important than anyone else when enteri g the house of God. The skip the line is for the Vatican museums which includes the Sistine Chapel. Trust me you want to skip the line !!!

All in all fantastic tour fantastic tour guide and thoroughly enjoyable

I have found tour guides in Rome essential to get the most from your visit. There are lots if visitors (it was Feb, out of season, and still busy) with many points of interest so an informed guide is by far the best option. Then there are many many tour companies to choose from!! This was a good choice!
Having only a basic knowledge of the Sistine chapel and Vatican city Guilliano our guide was enthusiastic, descriptive and knowledgeable. He was happy to answer any questions and kept the group personable by facing us even going upstairs 🙂

Marco was our tour guide and he was wonderful! Very passionate about his knowledge of this wonderful city! You can tell he really loves what he is doing. The tour was almost 3 hours and touched on such wonderful and colorful details of Vatican City. My fiance is Greek so we especially loved hearing about all the Greek influences here.

I was a little sceptical handing over money online for a tour guide but i needn’t have been. We had an Italian guise who had lived in Didcot. He took quite a large number of us round (approx 35) but his commentary was excellent and easy to understand. I would highly recommend this tour rather than buying one from the many tours that try and jump on you to go with them

Our guide was Laura. She was AMAZING! Laura Was friendly, knowledgeable, and very informative. She gave great insight on many of the beautiful paintings, sculptures, and artifacts. My family and I were speechless when in the presence of all the beauty the Vatican, Sistine Chapel & St. Peter’s Basilica had to offer. We would definitely recommend taking this tour and requesting Laura.
Thank you Laura!!!!

Fun tour. Norman our guide was excellent really knowledgeable. Slightly disappointed we didn't get to see more of the museum but worth it to ensure entry into sistine Chapel and short cut into St Peters.

We visited Rome in Sept 2019 (just getting round to doing some reviews!!) and pre-booked this tour of the Vatican to ensure we got the most out of our time there.

Giuliano was an exceptional tour guide, very knowledgable, courteous and helpful. We met at the offices, where Giuliano then took our group into a shaded area, to explain some details about the Sistine Chapel (Sept was unbelievably hot so shade was necessary!) as talking is not permitted once inside, it was nice to already have some prior information and knowledge of interior.

Once inside the Vatican, Giuliano gave us a great insight as to the vast history behind this phenomenal city. His knowledge of each part of the tour is amazing, and he really bought history to life whilst we walked round.

St Peters Basilica is far better in real life than you could ever imagine, intricately decorated with history spanning back years. And the Vatican Museums are treasures in themselves. The artwork, statues, sculptures and tapestry's are so incredibly beautiful.

For anyone looking to visit the Vatican, do so with Giuliano and his team. The knowledge you'll leave with is unbelievable.

I don’t normally take guided tours, but this was without doubt an informative tour and the guide in this tour was Juliano. This was handled well given the size of the group about twenty pax. He gave narratives and history a bit of life. We walked the for about 3 hours and went to the Vatican museum, followed by the Sistine chapel and was blessed on this occasion to be invited to confession with a priest. The painting are everything as you see in the books. The secret short cuts used to navigate to the Basilica were in themselves interesting. It would have been great to have walked the step or have been guided to where the step began at the Basilica. All up great tour, if you want to skip the line then this tour company is worth skipping with.
Thanks for a pleasant afternoon getting around the Vatican and giving good Pope stories and stories of the various artefacts.

Giuliano was great. Very friendly and practiced. The tour covered the main points of interest in the basilica, though not the crypts or the dome. (You can go back after the tour on your own though if those matter to you.) It also covered the museum very well, including the Sistine Chapel. Roughly three hours at a good pace, with lots of good places nearby for lunch—or a short cab ride back into the heart of Rome. There wasn’t much of a crowd because of off-season and COVID, so a great time to go for those who want more time with the art and to avoid both the rush and the heat of summer.

This is a popular and well organized tour. They split people into 4 groups, and my group had 20+ people.
My tour guide Giuliano is awesome and passionate about what he does. He provided lots of useful information in an interesting way. Well done and thank you!

This was a great tour. Went in October 2021, there was virtually no one in line and allowed to get much closer to the things you really wanted to see. We saw the Vatican, then the Vatican Museum then finished with the Sistine Chapel which is connected to the museum.

What a waste of time and money. Our tour guide was very hard to hear and the most unenthusiastic guide I've encountered. Didn't appear to enjoy her job! She focused on the wrong stuff in my opinion and didn't appear to be able to read the crowd. So many people left the tour as it was so dragged out.
After 3 hours we finally ended up entering the Vatican Museum, which the tour guide spent 30 minutes plus standing outside in the boiling sun showing us pictures on a poster board instead of just showing us in person in the museum.
Disappointed- wouldn't recommend.

Do it yourself.

We learned a lot on this tour and were in awe with the Vatican museum, the Sistine Chapel, and St Peter’s Basilica. Our tour guide, Valerie, was wry knowledgeable and easy to understand. Would definitely recommend.

The sights are awesome, but what makes them come alive is how Giuliano tells you the history behind the scenes so you know exactly what you're looking for. It was massively crowded but he expertly lead us through the tour effortlessly all the while chatting up more about what we were looking at. Bravo Giuliano, and thank you!!!

The tour was excellent. Our tour guide Gabriel was very knowledgeable and came prepared with an iPad full of pictures and information that he added throughout the tour. We learned so much even though we had seen the Vatican museums, Sistine Chapel and St Peter's before! We highly recommend!!!

Tour Guide Lucia made our experience fantastic!

Having been to the Peter's Basilica, the Sistine Chapel, and the Vatican museums before, I did not have high expectations for this tour, but I wanted my mother to have a nice visit, so we booked this tour. I was amazed at how much I enjoyed this experience. Lucia was so passionate and knowledgeable that I found myself in awe as though I was seeing this all for the first time. My husband and mother both agreed Lucia made this an experience to reember.

Thank you Lucia for returning the wonder of the Vatican to me. A very humbling yet deeply satisfying experience I won't forget.

Unfortunately I don't remember his name, but he was excellent. If the other tour guide are as good, then you will not have any issues.
The tour starts at their office and the hundreds of ppl are split into groups. If you can try asking when you get there if you can be the first group, otherwise you will be waiting a long time in the line to get into the Chapel. We were fortunate we were the first group.

I do recommend this tour company.

We had a great and very informative tour. Our tour guide was Marco and he was very knowledgeable attentive and quick to get us inside before the big line hit. It's 5 stars for a reason if you like history and are in Rome this is a must. We learned a lot and thoroughly enjoyed it!!!! Would highly recommend

We are a family of five (11, 14, 17 year old children) - and we did the Vatican tour. Phillipo was excellent - he is highly educated on the topics of art and history. Great communicator and a good sense of humor to boot.

If you’re in Rome and want an amazing experience, do this tour. Just make sure you get Marco, he was an amazing tour guide. Any questions people had he had the answer for it. He showed so much knowledge of all 3 phases of the tour, and was animated and showed his passion for history through it all. Very helpful, very insightful, you will not regret it. I’m not huge into history, art, or anything of that sort but after doing this tour, I’m absolutely fascinated thanks to the help of Marco. 10000/10 recommend.

Really enjoyed our tour with Giuliano( hope I spelt his name right) very friendly and informative guy, would highly recommend as we did skip all the lines. He was walking pretty much throughout the whole tour backwards so he could face us and talk directly to the group. Great value for money!!!

Unnecessary to get a "skip the line" tour right now, during slow season + covid. The lines are basically nonexistent everywhere.
Over-crowded group led to disarray and wasted time. We somehow got 2 people in our group of that weren't supposed to be, and we ended up losing time because the guide scrambled to figure out what to do. Not her fault, but that added to the feeling that EVERYTHING was rushed. No time for any kind of discussion, or information past what the guide sped through talking about. We both felt she went too fast with information. While the your company is great and awesome, and the guide was extremely nice, it didn't feel necessary to have a your like I was led to believe. Just buy your tickets in person, and get an audio guide if you want to learn more about what you're seeing.

Awesome experience and reasonable price for the service provided. It was very interesting having someone tell you all about the history behind the Basilica and Sistine chapel. Our tour guide was very knowledgeable and answered all of our questions. I would definitely recommend going on this tour.

There is a reason this is the top rated tour on TA.

Our guide Giuliano was the best, professional and knowledgeable in every way.

Not all tours cover St. Peter's and the Sistine Chapel, but this one does.

One small tip, after you exit the Sistine Chapel and finish the tour, make sure you go back in the museum and see Raphael's School of Athens painting as tour groups aren't allowed in that section of the museum.

Guiliano, our tour guide was top of the tops. Every 'skip the line' tour is great saving you time and effort but when it is done with a very knowledgeable, master in his work and smiley tour guide then it is fabulous!
The tour itself is very interesting with so many things to see and interact in limited time. Then it is Guiliano that makes it the more interesting with so much knowledge, ever willing to give you any detail on the smallest thing you see and always with a smiley and funny way!
I would definetely do it again trying to get even more from Guiliano!

Giuliano was our guide and he was great! Very informative and mindful of keeping us going. There’s so much to see so it’s good that he only touched on the more significant areas. I recommend the tour because you learn the big stuff versus guessing if the thing you’re looking at has any true relevance. Worth the $$ and your time!

We had a wonderful time.
Elaine our guide was most informative and good fun.
We were taken around St Peters Basilica and St Peters Square, the Vatican Museums and the Sistine Chapel.
There was so much more to see than we imagined, and Elaine explained everything there was to know in great detail.
This is an excellent time to do a tour like this as places are so much quieter than normal.
I would 100% recommend this company to everyone.
*one tip, our meeting place was a little hard to find, so allow an extra bit of time in case you get lost like we did!

A great tour. And well worth the money. Frank, the tour guide was a gent, seriously impressive and a fountain of knowledge. He went over the guide time (to 4 hours) as we were all engrossed with interest and Frank's stories! Highly recommend doing this

Juliano was an outstanding tour guide. He was very informative we felt we learned to much more about the Vatican City than had we done the tour on our own. Also extra kudos for the ability to walk backwards while communicating clearly despite the mask. Would recommend.

Rosanna with Rome Italia Tours booked us a memorable day with guide, Emiliano, to skip the line so we could see as much as possible while learning about what we were viewing. Do yourself a favor and don’t attempt the Vatican museums, Sistine Chapel without a guide! Of course, Luigi, our driver got us to the exact best location to start and end the day. There is so much history to see in Rome but you will learn so much more with a private guide and tour assistant!!! Rosanna can’t be beat!

Absolutely can't say enough good things about this tour. Giuliano was incredible, both at passionately guiding the tour itself but also explaining all the processes related to the tour and covid restrictions. If you're even remotely considering doing a Vatican tour, absolutely book this one!

(Oct 22) A well organised tour and do recommend booking in advance. This will save you valuable time as the area is extremely busy. The meeting point is easily findable, either on foot or by taxi and you will see other people there waiting to be put into groups. Well organised group with a very knowledgeable guide. All the facts provided makes it really interesting and informative, as there is a great deal to take in. You would miss so much if simply did on your own.

My partner and I booked a tour around Valentine’s Day with Made in Rome tours and we couldn’t have been luckier! Ciara our tour guide was the most bubbly, welcoming and enthusiastic person we came across during our stay, not only was she absolutely hilarious but she was extremely insightful into every little detail of the vast papal art collection helping us to truly appreciate the just how amazing it is, stopping to show us the little masterpieces while other tours strolled by without a glance. I can’t stress enough just how much her enthusiasm and charisma made the tour even more unique to the other dreary tours going on around us. The entire experience was truly unforgettable, we are both eagerly waiting to return to Rome to go on the tour again and experience it all over.

Thanks you so much Ciara!

From Alessandro & Alessandra
your London family xx

Juliano our tour guid was amazing. He speaks perfect english and is very knowledgable. The tour is a must if you are in Rome. Also we were lucky due to Covid restriction it was not crowded so we could enjoy all the amazing arts throughly and not being rushed

The adventure of our sightseeing Some of Rome's most interesting and beautiful cultural history was definitely something i won't forget it was a pleasure and our tour guide was a gentleman tieing in his roots and knowledge for our tour 3 hours of good fun and i highly recommend and highlight this as worthwhile. Thank you for a memory i wont ever forgot. Kind regards from Louis.

Outstanding tour guide. Chiara was engaging, funny and full of interesting facts regarding Italy, Rome and the Vatican. She clearly has passion for her job and passed on great information about Popes and the Catholic religion. I will recommend her to friends and family.

We were so glad that we took this tour of the Vatican museum, Sistine Chapel and Basilica. Francesca was knowledgeable and very funny and with the miles of exhibits on offer, it was great to have someone to pick out some of the more interesting features and tell us the relevant facts and tales. As previously warned, it was heaving with people and the ticket was worth the money just to skip the queue! But we came away with our heads buzzing with information and totally in awe of what we had seen. Thank you Francesca

This tour was 3 of the best hours i have ever spent. Our guide Marco was not only knowledgeable on all aspects of the tour, recalling places dates nemes and historical information with ease, but delivered the information in a fun and empathetic manner which enabled a level of understanding for every ability regardless of age. The cistine chapel was better than ever we expected then to see At Peter's following this was the icing on the cake. we were in awe of the achitects and decorators who created such wonders even as a none religiously minded person I was blown away.
Incredible tour incredible guide MARCO [ Incredibile Eu, Incredibile dux MARCO]

This tour started from outside their office with our Tour Guide, Marco, explaining all about the Sistine Chapel with the aid of pictures! Why? Because you're not supposed to talk in their and if you hadn't had it explained it really wouldn't make as much sense as it did!

Marco was very knowledgeable about his subject and clearly loves his work. He was also entertaining and fun ... and an on hand photographer to save you from the dreaded selfies ;-)

There is a lot of walking so take comfy shoes!

Would absolutely recommend this tour - great value for money and we learnt so much.

Thanks

What an incredible experience!! A must do when visiting Rome. Our tour guide Marco was incredibly informative and using the headsets worked really well even in crowds. The fact that you do not have to stand in the crazy long Vatican queue made this SO worth it!

Booked with Headout tours. Arrived on time to find out that the local provider had cancelled 10 days earlier. Information had not been passed on to us by HEADOUT. Contacted Headout who then emailed me with the cancellation information, 10 minutes after the proposed start of tour.
To late to book anything else and we had to leave Rome the following day.
Left very disappointed and would never use Headout again!

Our tour guide was very knowledgeable on all subjects and made the learning experience enjoyable. I don’t believe my wife and I would have appreciated the experience as much without her. We were in awe of the Sistine chapel and St. Peter’s Basilica. It’s incredible to see such beautiful pieces of art preserved well for this long.

We did the Vatican, Sistine Chappel and St Peters Basilica Tour yesterday (Sept 14) which, I believe, is the only tour which includes St Peters.

The guide, Julian, was extremely knowledgeable and we both found the tour extremely enjoyable.

In relative terms, these places have barely any tourists right now, due to Covid, so you're now looking at an ideal time to go visit because I don't think it will ever be like this again.

The trip more than lived up to our expectations and the communication was excellent, both in advance of and during the tour. We even managed to obtain a few good tips from Julian on where to eat, which we succestook him up on!

Go see it whilst there are so few tourists around!

The tour was punctual and well organized. Our tour guide was great too, he knew how to navigate the crowds so that we saw as much as possible and gave us lots of interesting information. The first headset kept falling off and had to be held in place which was bit frustrating but the second one was better.

Marco gave us an excellent tour. Just enough story and context to keep us all, including the young folks, fascinated. The day was serene, no lines, but the Skip-the-Line was totally worth it so we could be guided from place to place and given some insight into what we were seeing. Impossibly good.

This was very lovely. We had Lida as our guide and she was well informed and took great care of us. We literally skipped the queues and trying to do it yourself would take the whole day.
We were also granted special permission to exit the Sistine chapel through exit that is right by the Popes gate which was a lovely experience.
Absolutely would recommend it and it’s only 3hrs

Excellent!. First, it came with ear piece so you can hear the guide fully. second, our guide spoke perfect English we could understand, he was witty and sensitive, took time to answer our questions no matter how silly I think . I would highly recommend it so long as you get the same tour guide (British fellow I think).

There is really no such thing as skipping the line. Out of a 3.5 hour tour, 2.5 were spent waiting in the hot Sun or in some line. Our tour guide was well informed but not slot of personality. Next time I would go on our own to Basilica (same line) and go directly to The Sisteen chapel. Even with a wait, you would be done quicker.

We had a great tour. We went over 20 minutes but no complaints here. It was a little rushed just because there is just so much to see. We honestly could've spent 8 hours never made it through. Our guide was very accommodating and patient. We took our 9 month old with us using a stroller and he helped us make it a memorable tour. Only problem, out of his control, was the mic was often times not working well for us to hear him but no fault of his.

10/10 would recommend if you want to hit the hotspots.

Chiara ( our guide) made the experience very pleasant, highly recommendable, fun, and she was extremely knowledgeable. She gave everybody nicknames, which made it fun and she called us the California and the sisters. This is a must when you go to Roma and I believe our guide was the best.

This was a really great tour, Giuliano was an excellent tour guide and pointed out a lot of unique items in the museum that we definitely would have missed. Skipping the lines was also a HUGE lifesaver. Highly recommend!

The Vatican itself is amazing. We took this tour with our 3 young children, 13, 8 & 5. And found the guide to be too quick and stayed too long in sections. He didn't really try to interact with the kids and was moving so fast, which made it difficult to keep up. Especially when your kids want to stop and look at all the busts and paintings.
The place itself is amazing, but the tour did let us down a bit and we felt that we rushed it and didn't take it in as much as we wanted.

This was brilliant! Well worth the money in my experience. Marco was our tour guide and was a font of fact and figures. He made the tour interesting and had a good sense of humour.at each stage he explained the format of the tour and what we would do/ see next. All aspects of the tour were good. The Basillica was incredible.
We did skip the lines and I would highly recommend this tour especially if travelling alone.
I would suggest that a sign of some kind is put up at the meeting point for the start of the tour so people arriving early know that they are in the right place. It was well organised and a good experience.

The tour began on time and the people working at the office were very accommodating. Our tour guide spoke English but he was very, very brief and slurred most of the words making it difficult to understand. He also fought with mostly every other tour guide blaming them for him not having enough time to give us a more detailed explanation. The guy had an iPad with pictures and only showed us 2 and skipped what he didn’t like. Judge for yourself.

Ferdinando was absolutely amazing!!
He is humble, polite, respectful. He constantly made sure he had his entire group, he made sure each and every person had a working headset and working radio. His knowledge was beyond what I ever expected. The way he pays attention to detail. Until the very end he is observant to everything ❤️

Personally, seeing the unbelievable beauty in person was what I enjoyed the most. You read about it, you learn about it in school, you grow up as a Catholic embracing the Catholic religion but to actually experience the Vatican in person is something I will never forget. The Sistine Chapel a marvel of wonder and incredible masterpiece. The master work is beyond words.

The only thing that was disappointing was the instructor was hard to keep up with as they moved through the buildings. Very crowded and it difficult to see him. He did not have a flag or something to visually track and follow him in the large crowds. You had to be able to keep up with him moving throughout the buildings and I felt I missed out on a lot of what was being said as well because my ear piece kept falling off. He was very knowledgeable however.

As I participated in the exhibition of International masters in the Vatican we decided that the Vatican museum and the Sistine Chapel had to be part of our trip. We used an independent ticket bought on line which was 33euro for the 2 of us. We were Quickly inside to enjoy the Vatican Art. But it was very crowded !!!!!and beautiful!

I am so glad I chose to take this tour and I am thankful that I had Elaine as my tour guide. She loves her job and is extremely knowledgeable/personable. She was able to show us very interesting details that I dont think any other tour guide even knew. Elaine brought the Vatican to life for me and I am truly grateful.

People had told me to not pay the money for a guided tour and just to tour Vatican on my own, I couldn’t disagree more. It was a little expensive for the 2 of us, but in the end it was worth every penny paid. The experience would not have been the same without a tour guide. And speaking of tour guide, Nadia was an absolute credit to the company and the industry. Knowledgeable, kind, welcoming and genuinely made you feel like you were living in the moment. She also very kindly assisted us at the end of the tour to help get an invitation to the Papal Audience on the following morning which was very kind of her.

The skip the line element of the tour was also a very welcome addition.

Wonderful tour of the Vatican! Our family (2 adults + teen) did this tour last week. It was a great experience. Our tour guide knew so much about the art and the Vatican. The Vatican was crowded and I'm glad we did the "skip the line" version as it saved so much time. The lines to get in and between buildings was very long so it was well worth the money!

Totally rushed all the way round. Guide set off without us even though we were there 30 mins early Spoke very broken English Left us on our own and told another family to leave us behind. Luckily they refused and waited for us. Great place but didn’t really learn much

My husband and I booked this tour as a part of our honeymoon, which had been delayed for 2 years due to then pandemic. This was one of the activities I was most looking forward to.

Unfortunately, our plane was delayed, and would arrive in Rome nearly 8 hours later than expected, missing our tour and other scheduled events. I reached out to Get Your Guide to see if could rebook the tour to then next day.

They said since it was less than 24 hours, they were unable to assist me in any way. While I completely understand the company needs to have policies, there were open tours available for the next day they could have easily moved us to.

It was certainly a disappointment to not get any compassion for our circumstances, and a sad way to start a much anticipated and expensive trip.

Take my word when I say worth every penny booking this tour. Marco, our guide, was excellent. There is no way to know about the rich history of Rome (Vatican) without someone like Marco. He set context, pointed out to details which we would have otherwise missed, took us back in time with the most interesting stories, took care of queues/tickets/audio devices and even got us a picture before we started the tour. I am so stoked to have booked this tour. I recommend this tour for anyone visiting the Vatican.

Lucia, our guide, had a remarkable breadth of knowledge, was personable and attentive. The Vatican is a hectic experience due to the crowds, but Lucia was able to effectively usher us through the throngs. The tour company was well organized.

Robert was an EXCELLENT guide! He incorporated stories into the tour, with history and fun facts. He always set our expectations to know when we would have a line, when we could take pictures, when we would find a restroom, etc. We had a rainy day, but the tour was still so lovely! Highly recommend.

The trip organizer was very accommodative. We were 30 mins late, and the organizaer helped us join the main group. Really appreciated this help!
I felt the tour was very huried due to the time limit, not easy to understand what the tour guide was saying, i think because if the mask and the speed of talk.
Though we were told that she would answer questions after the tour, I was not satisfied qith the attention given to my questions.
In terms of help for delayed joining - extremely satisfied.
Tour - 5/10.

Very professional , As we expected so you come in and the group is around 15 to 20 people they provide you with a radio and headset. The tour itself Was great, Laura was amazing as well as manager. Our daughter got sick and they made sure that she is fine and offered to get us on a different tour . It’s almost 3 hours and flies by quickly . We had great time and will use them again .

Me and my grandson really enjoyed the tour, we had Marco as our tour guide, it was educational and we still remember many of the things he mentioned. We understood his english very well and are satisfied with the whole tour. My grandson said he especially liked how Marco included the crowd while telling the stories.

We do a lot of tours, and Giuliano was one of the best guides we've ever had. He was energetic and fun, without being annoying or fake. He was excellent at navigating us through the Vatican and avoiding crowds as much as possible, and he kept a good pace. He was super attentive to our 3 young children, and paid attention to our needs. I highly recommend this tour!

This tour was really well organised from the very start; our tour guide was so knowledgeable and clearly passionate about Rome and The Vatican. If my family and I were walking around it on our own, we wouldn’t have got anywhere near as much out of our visit without this tour and our guide. I feel that we have come away know lots about the history of it all and we’re totally fascinated by what we learned. I would highly recommend this to anyone visiting Rome - you will not be disappointed!

This tour could have been better managed. The first part in St. Peter's Basilica was nice but the Vatican Museums was awful! So crowded it felt like a "cattle call". We had to walk so fast that you couldn't enjoy the artwork on the walls or anything, for that matter. Too many people all at the same time. It was really not enjoyable at all. Our guide kept us out in the hot sun for a long time, I guess waiting for our turn to go to the museums. I would say, skip the Vatican museums and go to St. Peter's and spend some time there. It's an amazing place!

Skip the line wasn't skipping the line! Still waiting 45 minutes in the 90 degree weather to go through security with all the other "Skip The Lines" groups. By the time we got in it was full of people. Packed.

Nice tour guide.

The children with us, 11, 11 and 7, said it felt like 1.5 hours, not 3 hours. It was the best tour I have ever taken, in a long history of travelling across the globe and various tours. There were only 11 of us in our group and our guide “Raf” was interesting, enthusiastic, responsive and kind; we honestly could not have asked for more.

Great tour but a little too quick, we felt rushed through with not enough time to stop and look around. It was very busy and tour guide kept going so far ahead the headset connection would drop. Otherwise great! Thankyou.

I became short of breath and overheated just got alking to museum entrance. Staff called ahead to alert our group leader and someone from the office ran up the streets to help us. Very impressed with personal service! Highly recommend.

Booking and arrival process was simple and efficient. Our tour guide was informative, friendly, and clearly passionate about giving us the best possible experience. The depth of her knowledge throughout the Basilica, Vatican Museum, and in the lead up to the Sistine Chapel was exemplary. She also managed the organisation of a relatively large group with ease. Although we skipped the line to the Vatican Museum, we still had to wait while she collected our tickets, but this was 10 minutes max. All in all a great experience and would definitely recommend.

There were just too many people from start to finish to really enjoy what we were seeing. Trying to keep up with the group and listen on the headphones supplied at the same time was difficult.
