The commentary was often difficult to hear as the leader’s microphone kept dropping below his mouth and often walking at the same time. He did his best but should have stopped had the group together more before explaining what there was to see. Personally I would do it on my own with the personal head sets you can get there if I did it again. No more group tours for me.

It was way too crowded in the Vatican and Sistine chapel. Too many people are in the church and museum. The amount of people is overwhelming and disrupts the experience. The tour was too slow and too much time in the sun when it was over 100 degrees. Wish we skipped the Vatican and museum completely this time of year.

Lucia was an EXCELLENT tour guide and she made the Vatican City tour way more enjoyable. Her knowledge and awesome personality really provided us with an overall enjoyable experience. I would definitely recommend this tour for anyone who is looking to properly understand Vatican City. Thanks Lucia!!!

Chiara was an awesome tour guide. Okay she is a certified maniac when it comes to a high energy, quirky, irreverent, but not disrespectful approach to her tour. She sings parts of her narratives. Deep deep professorial knowledge. Memorized all our names in seconds. Boundless enthusiasm. Part Disney Chanel. Part History Cannel. Ask for Chiara. Max

This was a phenomenal tour and highly recommend. Everything ran smoothly. I would also recommend to book the earliest tour you can to beat most of the rush. We did the early time and when we left the lines were huge. Book in advance to get your day and time as these tours book up fast. Our guide had a bit of an issue with his microphone and kept breaking up and that was annoying. The locations of this tour speak for themselves so I won't go into detail. This is a must do in Rome.

This was a bad experience !!
The site said the tour was to last 3h it ran
4.5 hours
Being diabetic I Booked for an early start To avoid the crowds and finish on time for lunch
We arrived on time and started the tour but then
We were obliged to stay in St Peter’s square for 45 minutes waiting for more guests to join .
This delay caused havoc for the rest of the tour
Thé venu now was was very crowed we could not move and the guides English was not fluent .
2 in guest in my party were elderly I repeated had to tell her to slow down so they could catch up
She was rushing trying to make up the lost time
We were so late that guest left before the end of the tour
Over all what should have been a special life time experience was not good

Excellent tour. Everything is handled - if you are looking for convenience and getting by all the lines and seeing the essentials, this is it. I visited on a Saturday after a week's work in Roma. I am Swedish and based in NYC, so I have a bit of travel experience... It did not feel wierd to tour solo.

Our tour guide, Nadia, was fantastic. She navigated all the checkpoints with clear directions for what was happening (there are A LOT of lines, security, picking up tickets, getting headsets, etc.). It was so worth it to pay for a guide, it would have been a nightmare to do all that yourself! And twice (again at the basilica).

And then the wealth of information provided by Nadia about the masterpieces, preparing us for the Sistine Capel before entering (it's supposed to be silent in there).

I would highly recommend this tour.

Really great tour, well worth the money. Well organised and very informative. We didn’t have to queue for anything. We visited the Vatican on a Monday and it was busy as the Vatican is closed on a Sunday. Very knowledgeable tour guide.

Wow! This was even better than I could have hoped for, thanks to our unforgettable guide Marco. Marco was a FANTASTIC, ENGAGING, and SUPER FUN guide... truly, I don't think it gets better (and I am a former tour guide myself.) He led the tour with the perfect balance of teaching us important facts but also making it a memorable experience, filled with laughter. I like the fact that he's a native Roman and so it really felt like he was teaching us about his own history. We felt very looked after by him, and he was so great about truly connecting with everyone in our group, and answering all my Dad's questions. We were smiling the entire time. So grateful for the experience and I thought it was worth every penny. Bravo!

The organisation at the start was really good. Luciana was our guide and looked after the whole group. She negotiated the crowds well, and gave us insights into some of the treasures that you really only get with a knowledgeable guide. I really felt like we got our monies worth. I would recommend this company (and Luciana).

We had a fantastic time on this tour and would definitely recommend. Our guide was hugely knowledgeable and we would definitely not have learnt anywhere near as much if we’d gone around ourselves. The group size was small (8 people) which was great and we had an earpiece to hear what our guide was saying. All in all a superb tour!

We normally tour independently but decided to book this to avoid the inevitable lengthy queues at the Vatican and St Peter’s Basilica, and to avoid having to listen to a recorded guide. We knew we had made a good decision within a few minutes of meeting Guiliano. He is very knowledgable and friendly and brought the tour to life. Not having to think about where to get your tickets and trying to navigate your way around the Vatican made this an enjoyable hassle free tour. Guiliano regularly highlighted and explained things to us throughout the tour, which we would have missed if we had done this alone. We highly recommend this tour
Paul and Claire , uk

My sister and I took this tour on our recent trip to Rome. We met at the company office and walked to the Vatican. Our tour started at 12:00 and we didnot enter the Vatican until 1:25. Select a tour that meets near the Vatican.
Our group was huge with over 30 people. I was constantly hurrying to keep up and was frequently out of range of the headset. It wasn’t just me that was at the back. The group was so large that by the time I reached something that the guide was discussing I didn’t know what to look at.
The 3 hour tour is really 1 1/2 hours.

Another absolute must when visiting Rome. Our tour guide Gabriel was excellent, he was so passionate and well informed of everything about the Vatican and it’s surroundings. We saw everything we wanted to see and more and were taken into many other areas that others did not have access to.

That was a great tour! Sofia was an excellent narrator and the information we received was just enough. Luckily, there was almost no crowds so we could return to St Peter's to climb the stairs. I'd definitely recommend taking this tour, as it provides just enough information one can absorb.

Wow, what a fantastic tour. We read the reviews prior to booking and not only were our expectations met they were exceeded. Maria, our guide, was just outstanding. Full of knowledge and hugely entertaining. No queuing as advertised. If in Rome this is certainly a tour you must do, you will not be disappointed.

We had a wonderful experience with them from the day we booked our tickets! We received all the necessary information in advance and the staff organised the groups very efficiently. But on top of all things was Giuliano, our guide. The is an excellent communicator, full of energy and fun, who made our experience a memorable one.

What an awesome experience! What an awesome experience!
Chiara was amazing. She did such an incredible job of making sure we had so a special tour. Her knowledge and humor was so awesome. I would highly recommend this tour and if you get her as your tour guide, I can assure you that you will have an incredible time.

Our tour guide Julien was clearly passionate and loved all things Vatican, educating us along the way regarding the history of all the breathtaking displays infront of us. To top it off, he ensured almost seamless entry into both the basilica and museum on a busy day, leaving nobody behind. A true gentleman.

We visited Rome between Christmas and New Year and the weather was great. The tour office is small and tucked down a side street and was easy to find with Google Maps. We met Giuliano at the tour operators office and he gave a run down of the tour. We walked to the Vatican "skipping" past the very long queue waiting to get in and went fairly quickly through the security inspection barrier. Giuliano was like having your well informed big brother take you round always giving out information and making sure his "family" were keeping up with him. It was a great experience, thank you Giuliano.

Awesome tour, guide was amazing. I'd highly suggest this if you are looking for a guided tour. Very friendly and extremely well informed about all the locations. The tour takes you to almost anywhere you could want inside the vatican, and the guide gives plenty of time to take photos. And trust me, my mom was lagging behind taking photos, and he never rushed the group once. BUY THIS TOUR.

Chiara was funny, engaging and very knowledgeable of all things Vatican City. She took time to get to know everyone before the tour started and accommodated everyone’s needs. She is a native of Rome and wove small Italian lessons into the tour. We would highly recommend touring the Vatican with Chiara.

Absolutely brilliant tour, the Vatican is incredible. So pleased we booked for when it opened as it soon began to fill up and the queues were huge. We only waited 10 ish minutes to get in. Our guide was great, she showed us so many things, knew the history behind it plus some of the rumoured legends. We went into the crypts under the basilica and also into the Sistine chapel. We would have missed quite a lot if we’d gone in on our own. There is a lot of walking but it was relaxed and she gave us plenty of opportunity to fill our water bottles when needed (the heat was wicked!). I would highly recommend this tour, it’s worth the money just for the queue jump but the guide was amazing.

We absolutely loved our tour of the beautiful Vatican City. Our tour guide was Lucia, she was wonderful! Amazing English speaker, incredible knowledge and gave us a wonderful experience of the Vatican itself, about the pope and traditions, took us around the Vatican museum and Sistine chapel.
Even when the tour finished, we could stay in the museum for as long as we wanted and we went back to the Vatican as well so we could go up the dome of the Basilica!
Thank you so much!

I highly recommend this tour. Our tour guide was Juliano and he was extremely well-organized, entertaining and informative. He squeezed so much into the 3-hour tour plus answered all our questions and even took photos of all of us individually as well as a group photo. This was probably the best tour I've ever been on. You could tell that the company cares about its clients.

A very professional organised tour , our guide Lucia was very knowledgeable, lovely and catered to our every needs making it a smooth enjoyable time .
Would highly recommend this tour ! The places are breathtaking, so much to see and overwhelmingly good . I tried to rate this trip 5 stars but wouldn’t let me hit the 5 star button for some strange reason ? Great Value for money .

Amazing group tour with Guiliano, we were split into smaller groups to go round and were given interesting facts about everything we saw, could ask any questions we had and Guiliano could answer them all. Amazing time to see the Sistine Chapel with the limits on numbers in place. Definitely worthwhile booking this to be able to see and learn about all the history of 3 beautiful sites. You're also given opportunities to stop for photos or to carry on elsewhere at the end. Never felt rushed and came away knowing a lot more than when we started

Throughly enjoyed our tour. Very organized, the group wasn’t too big, our tour guide was very knowledgeable but kept it light and fun too! The hours flew by, bonus was skipping the lines. Totally recommend this tour. Norman was great!

No matter your religious background, I still feel that this tour could bring lots of value and awe to your travels. Your tour guide could make or break your tour, and we were lucky because I thought our guide, Santi, was excellent and funny. Despite his art background, he didn't bore us with too many dates/facts. He was kind enough to make sure we had enough time at the end to buy souvenirs. I would recommend this tour to my parents and friends mos def

This is a wonderful tour of St. Peter’s, the Vatican, and the Sistine chapel. While we covered a lot in three hours especially the highlights and some unique facts about each location, there were still a number of things we couldn’t cover and came back later. Be prepared for crowds of people as this is one of the most popular tourist and pilgrimage sites. Even with skip the line access, there were a number of points where we waited in line.

Your was great and St. Peter’s was stunning! We had a unique opportunity to go see the tombs of the deceased popes beneath the church. Compared to other tours in Rome we went in this one felt a little rushed and we didn’t get to see as much as we wanted because we would be moving on. I would still recommend you book it. Very popular attraction, having the tour was a major plus to quite literally “skip the line” in some places.

The visit to the Vatican exceeded all my expectations. It was fun and very relaxed. All because of our guide Mr Giuliano. He is extremely knowledgeable, fluent in English and a great lover of the Roman art and history. He made the visit to the Vatican even more magical. I enjoyed the visit enormously and learned a lot from him. So if you are planning a visit to Rome book here, ask for Giuliano and you’ll have the best tour ever. Grazie Mille for this fantastic tour!

A brilliant way to experience Vatican City and its surroundings. Julio was awesome, very knowledgeable and accommodating to everyone on the tour. Nothing was too much trouble and all questions were answered. Definitely worth it if you’ve never been before and want to experience as much as possible - just remember comfortable footwear!

Everything was well organized except for the wait for other people to show up. We waited about 20 min. for our tour to start and the line to get in the security checkpoint was considerably longer than it was 30 min. earlier when we went by on our way to the meeting point. One couple did join us while we were already in line waiting to get through security, so why did we just wait for them? The guide was knowledgeable and pointed out the highlights.

Paola was so friendly, knowledgeable and she ensured we all understood the information and kept up. Highly recommend for future travellers. We got to use the Royal Steps to exit the Sistine Chapel straight to the Basilica which we are told was very lucky.

The skip the line really helped a lot. Our tour started at 9am and there was a line already all the way down the road. Between the museum and st Peter we saved 2 hours. Our tour guide was good and provided the missing information to better understand what we were looking at.

Our tour of the Vatican, Sistine Chapel & St. Peter's Basilica was excellent! Our tour guide Marco was very knowledgeable, friendly, and knew how to keep the pace so that we could see all the highlights of these amazing places. He shared very important, detailed information along the tour and even took the time to take pictures of everyone in the tour. I recommend this tour 100%.

The guide was nice, but we could not understand him very well. We were there early enough to skip the crowds going in. However, we did not skip the line at the Vatican Museum portion of the tour. We were not prepared for the crowd inside the Sistine Chapel. We were like sardines in a can. That is not the tour’s fault, but it was quite a contrast to when I visited in prior years. Basically, the tour guide showed us where to go and there were some tid bits of information we found interesting. Unfortunately, we all wish we understood him better.

Really knowledgeable tour guide. Easy to understand English speaking. The tour is very long, but you fit a lot in. I recommend doing the 9AM time as you get to see more. Be ready to wait in security lines and Covid vaccination checks, no tour can bypass those.

This was a great tour provided by Julian. He was extremely knowledgeable and a great speaker who kept us all engaged and listening. The tour went by so quickly, I couldn’t believe the time when I checked my watch. This tour was really easy to book and straight forward to follow. Thanks for a great day out. Memories made forever.

Difficult to hear our tour guide, even with earphones. She had a strong accent that was difficult to understand and the group size made it hard to follow. We would be looking at one thing while she described another due to the group size.

Giuliano was definitely the best tour guide we had on our trip to Rome. He spoken excellent English, moved round the attraction at a good pace (including allowing plenty of time for us to take in certain bits by ourselves). Worth the price for the skip-the-line admission, and the brilliant guide made it fantastic value

What an amazing tour! Our guide, Marco was really knowledgeable and super personable. Getting an early tour is the way to go! St Peter's Square was empty and the lines for the Vatican went fast. Marco really highlighted all of the "Must Sees" at each location. He gave us time to really appreciate the history and beauty all around. Check in was super easy and my 3 children (16,14 and 11) loved how engaging Marco was with them. He even helped us get to the Raphael Rooms at the end of the tour and gave us a recommendation for a yummy lunch!! Don't hesitate to book this tour

Excellent tour!! We got lucky as it ended up being a relatively small group of 9. Giuliano was fantastic, lots of fantastic small interesting details. He was also very mindful to keep us cool in the shade on a day that was exceedingly hot. He also took some fantastic photos of everyone. He’s also very well known amongst the officials/guards in the Vatican and we got to skip through the line as a result. He was also very clear and easy to understand. I’ve taken many tours over the years and this was definitely one of the best!

We would recommend this tour. I booked it a few weeks prior to going and we could cancel right up to the day before. The tour guide sent a very informative text the day before explaining the tour. She also answered more queries about the best way to get there from where we stayed.
Our guide was Lucia and she was extremely knowledgable. We learned a lot. It was nice to have a guide and I would highly recommend especially to skip the line. St. Peter’s basilica was really amazing. I find stories about the saints so interesting. You can even go up inside the highest dome of the basilica.
Overall the tour was fab.

Marco was outstanding! His expertise and knowledge of history combined with a great personality made the experience rewarding. The details of dates, timelines, mixed with history made the tour very engaging and interesting. I felt like I was in an art history class at the university. Thank you for making the experience a memorable one. I highly recommend Marco as a tour guide. He's a rock star!

We thoroughly enjoyed our tour with our very informative tour guide Lucia who added so much interesting detail. The in-ear commentary was excellent and meant although St Peter's and the Vatican Museum were busy, we could still hear Lucia clearly. She also advised us regarding revisiting parts of the route afterwards if we wished. Very welcoming guide, thank you.

Very well run tour. Our guide, Lucia, was very knowledgeable and an excellent guide - remembering everyone’s name in our group. It felt fast paced - the three hours flew by. We would’ve preferred more time in the Gallery of Geographical Maps and less of some of the other areas. The Sistine Chapel we saw at the very end - which by then my teens were flagging and wanted to get to lunch.

Our tour guide Giuliano was fantastic! Very knowledgeable about Roman history, easy to work with and also went above and beyond to make sure we had a great experience.

Due to a slight detour that we took, my family and I ended up in a one way near the Sistine Chapel and missed the entry to St. Peter's Basilica. Giuliano called me promptly, walked 15 mins to come get us, and also helped us navigate the entry.

I highly recommend "Made in Rome Tours" and will definitely seek out Giuliano when I go there next!

This was a WONDERFUL experience thanks to our amazing tour guide MARCO, and his boss Giuliano! Insightful fun tour with memorable factoids and highlights! The tour even kept my 15 year old daughter engaged. Great sense of humor and historical significance. Just remember to wear an outfit that covers the shoulders and extends to the knees, and take passport/ID and vaccine cards.

This could’ve been overwhelming but our tour focused on wonderful highlights. The whole thing took about 3.5 hours (9 am-12:30 pm).

St. Peter’s and the Sistine Chapel were breathtaking.

Special experience that I will always remember, highly appreciation for our guide Chiara, she was more then a guide, considering the attention and carefully way of introducing us to the history and the beauty of Vatican , Sistine Chapel and St Peter's Basilica. She presented the most important historical events and facts in a wonderful manner, with lot's of details. Friends from Romania.

Excellent tour in every way. The guide was very friendly and was a wealth of information and made sure we had plenty of time for capturing memories and was genuinely happy to share his knowledge with us. If we could of we would of booked him out for the whole of our trip to show us the entire history of Rome.

Marco was an amazing tour guide! I was late about an hour due to traffic, but Marco still took me in and caught me up to what I missed on our walks to the next destination. He made me feel at home and was very informative and funny as he passed along the Information on the tour. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking to book this tour. It’s worth everything and much more than what you pay for it!

Guide Lucia was disinterested because she behaved as if we were a burden all morning. He was in a hurry all the time and every 15 minutes he said "go there, I will meet you there". At one point he handed me a selfie stick that was used as a sign so we would not get lost.

There is so much history in the place and is sad to be run in a hurry.

Marco our guide was a fountain of information. Although 3 hours is not enough, Marco tried to squeeze as much as possible in the stipulated time. Would definitely recommend this team for your tour of the vatican. Its total value for money as well.

Informative, Entertaining, There was an older woman in the group we joined that had come by herself, she was having difficulty navigating. The tour leader, told her "I am making you my special assistant" He lead our entire tour with her holding on to his arm for assistance. He did it in a kind, friendly way so as to not make her feel bad, and it kept the tour on pace.
I have ever had a better tour experience, and I am sure I have never witnessed such kindness from a tour operator.
Fantastic!

I really liked how organized they are and how passionate and knowledgeable the guides are. The day before we received an email reviewing the important information on meeting point and things to take with us for the tour. The next day at the meeting point it was well organized giving numbers as you arrived and then each guide will call out the number for you to go with them. We did the tour with Laure and let me tell you, she is just AMAZING! She knows a loot about history and she is passionate about telling you all, do not hesitate to ask her questions. Definitely recommend this!

We (two adults and two 16 years olds) absolutely loved our tour with this team. Norman was our guide and he kept it fun, interesting and stimulating all at once with age/generation appropriate anecdotes that kept us all interested and engaged.
We were guided through history in the Vatican museum, the Sistine chapel to end in St Peters basilica where he generously gave us a history tour, some fun anecdotes and pointed us in the right direction to complete the experience according to our priorities (tombs, gifts or more of the basilica OR all of the above!).
From start to finish this was a very well organized tour with manageable and small groups and clear instructions.
The texts and emails to confirm meeting points, timeline and other details were a great touch to make thingsore fluid and less stressful.
Thank you gang for the fabulous experience.
We did many tours in our travels and this ranks at the very top.

The in depth knowledge of guiliano was superb. The trip was well organised and flowed excellently. His nuggets of local information added to the experience. Overall an excellent tour! I'd highly recommend to those who want the full vatican experience

Putting the Pictures and Videos that you see so many times on Films & TV into a reality is fantastic enough, add into this an amazing tour guide in Fernando. His personal stories and experience in his professional life definitely add to the story’s he tells and the amazing history behind the Vatican.

Cannot recommend enough!

Laura was our tour guide and she is very knowledgeable and you can tell how passionate she is with the beautiful history of Rome. She made our tour very easy despite it being too hot in Rome. She takes extra mile to accommodate all of us. Will definitely recommend them.

We visited Rome just as the lockdown hit, so there weren’t that many tourists around . The tour was fantastic. Our guide was a wealth of knowledge and on top of it it was so quiet so that we had great views of everything there’s to see and experience. Highly recommended.

We went on a guided tour, with Marco. We were very happy with our guide. He walked and talked, and made sure we did not hade to wait so long in the queue. He was good to answer questions, but nicely, went back to the story when some visitors started to talk about other things (which were irrelevant to the rest of the group).

We really really wanted to love this experience - however the whole thing just felt so rushed and wasn't as great as other tours we did in Rome. We were late leaving the tour office, so we didn't get to spend as much time at the Sistine Chapel (we had to leave promptly at the end of the tour). The tour guide was lovely, but I felt more attention could have been paid to other areas. We spent a lot of time looking at signs and not as much time seeing the actual art, and you could see people zoning out occasionally.

The knowledgeable tour guide Marco. I got on the wrong bus and was a little late and another company said just get a refund bc you would no longer honor my ticket. Fortunately I looked at my phone and the rep came and got me and said don't pay a thing and I enjoyed my whole tour. Loved the whole experience!

Lucia, our guide, was excellent, well informed and full of valuable information. My husband and I are not fast walkers and she always made sure we were with the group before moving on or giving information. She knew her group both by sight and by name. Well done, would definitely recommend.

This was hands down worth doing. We had Julian and his knowledge was astonishing. My partner and I really enjoyed the tour. Very friendly, gave us plenty of time and the level of detail he spoke about during the tour was unforgettable. Highly recommend Julian.

Our first ever guided tour and Chiara (our brilliant & hilarious tour guide) always kept us fascinated & educated about each site visit. Follow her red umbrella and you won’t be lost! She has a way of keeping the group alive and interested. Chiara keeps her group engaged by checking in with each of them and “incorporating” where everyone is from. Her knowledge is impressive from the beginning to the end. Xoxo from your Seattle sisters.

We had a fantastic time during our tour of The Vatican, Sistine chapel & St Peters Basilica. Our tour guide was Giuliano and we honestly could not have asked for a better more interactive / informative tour guide with a great sense of humour . He really made it an amazing experience . The minute we entered the Vatican we were astonished by the beauty . Would highly recommend this tour as something everyone should do while visiting Rome . We will Definitely be back !😃

We only had 3 days in Rome and wanted to see as much as possible. This tour was absolutely perfect! We saw everything in the Vatican that mattered and heard all the stories behind it. Our guide was a great storyteller and really made the tour worth its money.

Marco's passion and knowledge for the Vatican and it's history was self evident. We were totally absorbed during the tour and wished that we could have spent more time with him. The detailed insight he provided on the Sistine Chapel was extraordinary. Well worth the money.

Our tour guide Marco was fantastic. He was friendly, funny and informative. He gave enough time for us to see everything and take in what he was telling us and was always ready to answer our questions. We thoroughly enjoyed it, and it was excellent value for money. Thank you!

I’ve been 3 times at the Vatican and this was the best tour I’ve ever had. I booked a 9am tour, the office is very close to the Vatican. Our guide was genuinely friendly, extremely knowledgable (10 years or more of experience) and made the entire process informative, entertaining, and relaxing and we skipped all queues! The tour never seemed to spend too long on boring details or waiting forever, the guide was a joy to listen to and an encyclopaedia of knowledge. If you’re looking for a pleasant, informative and stress free tour that doesn’t take all day, this is the tour for you! Fantastic!

This is not a tour but simply gets you into the Vatican Museum/Sistine Chapel. After we were in our 'guide' disappeared. The Vatican like to do their own guided tours for 80euros or so. This did indeed get us straight into the museum but at the time we went there were no queues! So we could have entered for 17 euros each.

We recently took the Vatican, Sistine Chapel and St Peters Basilica guided tour and it was fantastic. Really good value for money. Our guide Giuliano was very knowledgeable and accommodating throughout the entire tour. This made the trip even better. Thank you Giuliano.

We took this tour with Giuliano, everything about the tour was fantastic! It was our first time in Rome and we were very happy we chose this company. Our tour guide Giuliano was extremely knowledgeable, friendly, and super fun! You could tell that he was very experienced with this tour and enjoyed leading it. Even with a very busy day at the Vatican he was able to keep the group together and ran everything smoothly. I recommend this tour to anyone visiting Rome!

julian the guide provided two and a half hours of insights into history, arts and personages of the vatican, the sistine chapel and st. peter’s basilica. we skipped lines and had extra time to look around on our own. a fun and knowledgeable tour.

The Vatican is a must see, especially as a skip the line tour. Giuliano was the best tour we had out of the four tours we took in Europe. He was very knowledgeable and friendly. He told us to watch where he was going for him so he could walk backwards and explain things to us along the way. Both my husband and I studied the Vatican prior to our trip, but Giuliano presented tokens of knowledge and history on us that we didn’t catch in our guidebooks. He was easy to understand and so passionate. As I mentioned, we took a few other tours, and we were not impressed with the guides. Giuliano was wonderful and I’d highly recommend his tour to anyone.

Very professionally organised. Our guide was very well informed and provided excellent historical updates through the headsets provided.
Tour lasted approx 4 hours. Could spend double the time there and even that wouldn’t come near seeing a fraction on what is to be seen. Tour commenced as advertised so advice is to be there before time.

Super well organized tour and just the right amount of information to inform but not overwhelm. There were a ton of other tourists so it was very crowded but having the headset made this much less of an issue. For those wondering accessibility there are lots of steps up and down with people all around you.

My favorite tour in Rome. My husband and I learned a lot about all three locations, the tour guide was very knowledgeable and gave us a lot of great tips that we used in the rest of our journey through Rome. 10/10 would recommend. Giuliano was great!

I thoroughly recommend this tour! We had an excellent guide in Chiara who was fun, knowledgeable and remembered all our names. She sorted out all the admin and we really did skip the lines! She showed us some of the amazing sights and gave lots of information about what we were seeing. The St Peter's Basilica and Sistene Chapel are a must see in Rome and I can't imagine a better way to see them. Many thanks Chiara also for the great restaurant recommendation!

This was an amazing tour. It really included as much as possible in the three hours. Our tour guide made it extremely interesting and fun by having little quizzes throughout the tour. Would definitely recommend this tour

I could not recommend this tour enough! Marco was an amazing guide with lots of knowledge and personality to go with it. We heard several other tour guides and Marco made everything so interesting and getting the kids involved. We skipped every queue and although three hours long our two children (12 and 15 year olds) were never bored!
Thank you so much for an amazing experience, we will be back!

Five groups went out. They could have organized tour into groups based on pace. Our group had a person on crutches and some elderly people who felt bad slowing the group down. It was awkward for everyone. Guide talked very very slowly. Some people had to cut out bc tour was going on for so long. Organizers just wanted to pack people into even groups and go. With some foresight and planning, they could organize the groups and make it enjoyable for everyone.

He didn't have a flag to help find him in the crowds, he walked too fast. We lost him and didn't get to see the last attraction we paid for. He lost 2 people before we even got into the building because he walked so fast. He didn't seem to care. We do not feel we got our money's worth and didn't get to see one of the biggest attractions in Rome, St. Peter's Basillica. I feel we should get our money back.

I have been to the Vatican 2 previous times without a guided tour. This time with a guide I understood and learned so much more than when I was on my own. However this isn’t really a skip the line tour. You still have to arrive 30 minutes before the tour at the tour office. The registration was disorganised and too long. But once we were assigned our guide we were on our way. The security line at the Vatican was crazy when we arrived at 9:00am. We waited 45 minutes the get through security. When we left the Vatican at 10:30, the line was 3 times as long. So I highly recommend an early tour. Laura, our guide, was very informative and very patient and professional. She answered all our questions. Our tour did run over our 3 hours because of all the waiting, but we appreciated that Laura didn’t rush us through because of it. I would recommend this tour.

A fantastic and informative day, there was no way we would have been able to see and learn as much as we did, if we had toured in on our own. Lucia was our guide, and she was informative, funny and made the whole tour enjoyable , giving us plenty of added info for later in the day . Would definitely recommend this tour. Thank you for a great day

We had a truly amazing time on this tour courtesy of our guide Lucia. She was extremely thorough in all the areas we visited and was evidently an expert. It made the experience that much more interesting to not only see the beauty but to learn the story behind it. Grazie mille and we look forward to returning in the future!

First, it is an absolute must to «skip-the-line» when visiting the Vatican as the queues outside grow enourmously long. This is definitely worth the pay.

This deal lets you see the very best of what the Vatican has to offer. I would not have dropped either the museum, sistine chapel or the Basillica. This package has it all.

At last I would like to add that our guide with this company, Ahmed, had an incredible knowledge of the Vatican and its history. This made the whole experience even more fascinating.

I strongly recommend this company.

We took this tour as a part of our senior trip to Italy, and our tour guide Marco made us fall in love with Rome. It was hot and our feet hurt, but we would have walked for days in the heat just to hear him tell us, with unparalleled enthusiasm, about the Basilica’s history and the highlights of the Vatican museums. Such a good time!

Giuliano, wow what a tour guide!! This man is a book of knowledge. This tour was excellent and a great way to spend the day in the Vatican. Would most definitely advise tourists to go on this tour. Was great during COVID times as the crowds were minimal and could get right up close to all the main attractions. The tour was almost 4 hours and was value for every cent. Headsets are provided for clear audio throughout the tour. Best experience of the holiday!

We had a fantastic experience touring the Vatican with Julliano. We were guided from the trip provider office to St Peter's Square, then on to the Vatican Museum, Sistene Chapel and to the entrance of St Peter's Church. Julliano was friendly, full of energy and his knowledge was second to none. With his guidance, we learned a great deal about the Vatican, ancient Rome and current life in the state. All the sites were breathtaking - we were truly taken aback. Well worth paying a little extra to skip the line (the queue was huge) and to invest in a tour guide to make the most of your visit.

I thought this was an excellent tour, especially for the price compared to many other tours. Very informative we had a gentleman called Roberto as our guide and it was impeccably organised. We met at their office close to the square and then skipped the line to the Vatican museum, basilica and Sistine Chapel.
I would highly recommend

Our tour guide was awesome! Professional and very informative. I enjoyed the way he would constantly ask us questions. It kept the group engaged and it really helped me remember important facts about Roma’s fantastic history. If you go to Rome, you have to book this tour!

What an awesome experience in all of these places. This tour is why you go to Rome. Bring your camera and take in all of this creation. No big crowds currently which was amazing. Our guide was Chiara and she was so knowledgeable about the history and to top it off she is hilarious. Personality plus for sure. Loved her!

Our guide was incredibly knowledge, friendly, and entertaining. She kept a great pace and was careful to include everyone and took time to answer questions and let us take pictures. Thank you for a wonderful morning.

Great tour. Very well organized, our tour guide knew about the places, focused on the important attractions. One thing that I would have liked is to go downstairs at St Peter's Basilica, where the popes and St.Peter are buried. I went down there after the tour.

Four days ago we took the Vatican tour with Marco as our guide. I fully recommend it. These are must see attractions when visiting Rome and Marco was very organized, kind, funny, made us feel very comfortable and he was very efficient in this 3hour tour. Thank you Marco for making this unique tour even more amazing!!!

Since it was not long after Corona Lockdown and the tour started at 9 am St. Peter’s Cathedral was almost empty.
Our guide Giuliano is the best guide I’ve met in Rome during my stay till now. He speaks excellent English, is very informative and takes care of his guests.

Recently took part in this tour with 3 others. Our guide Giuliano was very knowledgeable. He shared his knowledge with enthusiasm. He also gave us time to appreciate our surroundings. He was happy to answer our questions. This trip was great value for money and we all enjoyed it immensely. The tour lasted about 3 hours but never looked at my watch. We also went up St Peter’s dome at the end which was an additional cost but worth it on a lovely day.

The tour guide was excellent. Fun and informative. The disappointing thing was the description of the tour implies no wait. The description should include that participants may have a long wait to get through security. Our group waited an hour. Giving some idea of the waits would help people plan their days accordingly.

Easy meeting spot, good organization by the staff. Our guide was informative and fun. I cannot stress enough the importance of bringing your own bottled water. Once you start the tour, there is no opportunity to buy or refill bottles for the entire 3 hour tour. Most of the tour is not air conditioned. None of this is the fault of the tour, just an FYI.

Marco is a great tour guide - very knowledgeable with infectious enthusiasm. I have visited the Vatican and the Sistine Chapel before and I cannot believe how much I missed. The tour took about three hours and the time flew by. If you are considering a guided tour of the Vatican I highly recommend this company.

I’m so glad I booked the Skip the Line tour after seeing the queues. Our tour guide was friendly and welcoming and kept us informed of what was happening and what to expect. He was very knowledgeable about the history of Rome and the Vatican and I found the tour far more informative and interesting than I feel I would have if I had gone around on my own.

We took the guided tour of the Vatican museum, St Peters Basilica and the Sistine Chapel. It’s overwhelming choosing a tour company online not knowing anything about them. We chose wisely with Made in Rome Tours. Our guide, Giuliano, was wonderful! Engaging, friendly and knowledgeable. You won’t regret signing up. Be prepared to walk. A lot! Well worth every step!!

We had a great guide and a great experience. You do skip some lines but you will still have to wait with everyone else to go through security so be prepared to stand out in the sun for a long time. There are no places to sit down or really get out of the sun so just be aware. I would definitely recommend this though, it was very informative.

Good overall experience. Not really a skip the line. Still needed to wait through security which is the longest line. Was able to see most of the sights we liked but the tour guide definitely rushed through. Group members were “lost” multiple times. I understand that is was busy. But still needs to be a better way to identify who is in your group. Would do again if in the area but would expect a better experience.

We are so glad we booked a tour. It helped us navigate a massive complex in 3 hours that would have taken all day. Or several days. I wouldn’t necessarily say this was a “skip the line” tour it seemed to be crowded entrances everywhere but I think that’s how it goes.

St Peters Basilica is a magnificent building and the tour was first class.Norman our guide had an exceptional knowledge of the Basilica and the Vatican museum. He was informative and very pleasant. It was a little hard on the feet for walking around but well worth it.
Highly recommend.

I cannot recommend this tour enough, so simplistic and easy to organise. We received a WhatsApp message with instructions of how to get to the meeting point, what we need and tour schedule soon after booking.

Our tour guide Giuliano was so friendly and extremely knowledgeable of everything. He made our day.

Nice small group of about 20 people. The guide was very informative, and I would have missed a lot if it wasn't for the guide. There is so much to look at, but the guide pointed out the more important items and the history behind it. I highly recommend this tour.

This was an excellent tour! Marco was awesome. A perfect guide who led us smoothly through the rich history.
The tour was perfectly on time, no lines or loosing time, very well organized with small groups and taking care of all the measures.

I would strongly recommend this tour to everybody. Value for money.

Great tour. Great tour guide.

There's a lot to see in a short time so if you are looking for an opportunity to see the best bits and get a slice of history, this is a great option. You will see a ton of stuff you don't have time to get all the detail of, but if you are comfortable with moving with a touch of pace you will be happy.

Thanks to Lucia.

This tour was amazing, the tour guide was very knowledgeable and was great throughout the tour. He knew everything about the Vatican, Sistine chapel and St Peter’s Basilica. The tour lasted a good amount of time and you never felt rushed walking around. It was a once in a lifetime experience and it was like nothing we had ever done before. I would 100% recommend this tour to anyone visiting Rome.

We found Marco brilliant. Very informative, engaging and easy explanations without bombarding us of the Sistine chapel Michelangelo St. Peter basilica little optical illusions pointed out too which is always a bonus. Loved every minute of it highly recommended

Our guide was so knowledgeable about the area and the history, he made the long wait in security fly by. (no fault of the tour company, just very busy being in Rome in July). Saw all the sites, heard all the information - very well organized. We would recommend!

It's hard to fail with such impressive material as the Vatican City. Our guide Lucia got a little bit frazzled from time to time but overall did a very good job. This was a good way to see these historic buildings. One point - the COVID information about what is required to visit the Vatican is way out of date. In fact, most of the restrictions have been dropped now.

Excellent tour with Marco our guide. I felt well briefed on what to expect and he had a great knowledge of the history that he delivered in a very accessible style. We went on a fairly quiet day but it was obvious that the Vatican is a place that you need a clear plan and some discipline as a group to make the most of your visit. We felt in safe hands and thoroughly enjoyed ourselves.
No waiting, really quick entrance. The tour guide Claire, knew her art and gave us an in depth history of the Sistine Chapel prior to going through. Well worth the experience.

I mean we are talking about visiting the Vatican, and the Sistine Chapel, and the St. Peter's Basilica. The amount of art and history contained here is staggering. Our tour guided Guiliano was amazing. I will remember all that he said. He was baptized in St.Peter's Basilica, I found that so special that now he gives tour of it. He is from Venice, and his knowledge was incredible. I would definitely love to take this tour again, so much Art and History. To see the works of the great masters is inspiring. I learned so many interesting facts about the Sistine Chapel, I thought I knew a lot. But the passion of Guiliano just added to the admiration of such a beautiful historic place. I would highly recommend the tour for everyone.

A wonderful last day in Rome with Bob's expert guidance and passion for this must see experience. Group size was perfect and just enough information about the sights and what to look out for without over whelming us. Great info received the evening before about paperwork we needed with us and dress code.. All very stress free. If you are thinking of doing this .....do! Highly recommended trip

Excellent experience. Marco is a very well-versed guide, and knew how to keep an audience entertained. I can’t recommend him enough. I would definitely appreciate a longer tour, mostly through the Raffael area, but all in all, a great experience.

Well-organized tour that was wonderfully led by Bob. A lot of things to squeeze in 3.5 hours but it was a great pace and highly enjoyable. I especially liked the small group size. Highly recommend Made in Rome Tours for touring the Vatican!

From reading other reviews, I hoped for the best. This tour was amazing!!! I learned so much and the Vatican, St. Peter’s and Sistine Chapel were unbelievable! The Sistine Chapel brought tears to my eyes. Gioia was our tour guide and was extremely knowledgeable. I took notes on the tour. You will not regret this tour!

Lucia was the best. I have been waiting a long time to visit Rome and this seemed like the perfect opportunity. Weather in late October was fantastic and the tour matched it. Our guide was enthusiastic and very knowledgeable about everything. Not only did she know her stuff there was a genuine love in her subject that came across. You need to do this.

Just wow. Obviously I haven't done any other tour of this ilk but quite honestly I wouldn't want to. It was very busy in the area but Julian kept good control and still made the tour very informative and totally brilliant. Definitely 100% recommend

A fun, entertaining, engaging tour. The host, Giuliano, was knowledgeable of all points of interest throughout the tour. He was quick to answer all questions any visitor had. You could feel the passion and pride he has while he explained all the sights. 10 out of 5 stars. Take this tour, you won't be disappointed

Julian was a great tour guide. Kept our group together in the hectic mess that is the Vatican. Super knowledgeable but kept up with the pace required by the Vatican to keep everyone moving and courteous to other groups. Managed the group so we could get into St Ps around the Pope’s schedule and gave us all the tips for walking the dome, mailing postcards and avoiding the tourist traps for lunch post tour. Made a great day.

Adults and kids alike, it’s a great experience with amazing authentic Italian food. Our tour guide was a local named Irina and she was the best! She engaged the group and was attentive to everyone. I highly recommend this tour, you won’t be disappointed!

Great way to visit the Vatican and St Peter’s Basilica. Lucia was very friendly, informative, and gave great tips for continuing our exploration after the tour. Checking in was super easy and the experience was great. I would definitely do this again.

This was a great tour! Our guide, Gabriel, was extremely knowledgeable and enthusiastic. The Vatican happened to be particularly busy yesterday when we did the tour, so it was a hectic experience beyond the control of the tour company. However, notwithstanding that challenge, we learned a lot and are very thankful that we were able to take this tour! Highly recommended!

Tour guide’s knowledge of the area that we toured was great. Spoke English very well and made sure we were always accounted for in the group. Questions were answered. The whole tour was great. Skipping the line was definitely worth the extra dollars.

We had an amazing tour with Lucia of the Vatican City. She was knowledge, friendly and so organized that we felt like it was a perfect adventure. Lucia knew I everything and we felt very informed. Every step was worth it, especially the high hour long wait lines we passed right by. Thank you Lucia.

The tour was amazing. So informative and educational. I learned so much about the Vatican and Sistine Chapel and Italy in general on the tour. Despite Covid conditions as well as traveling alone, I felt very safe. Tour guide Marco was very good at keeping us all engaged and informed.

Today we had a guided tour with Chiara. She is a fantastic enthusiastic guide. We enjoyed the tour very much and learned a lot about the history of Vatican City. Thank you for the good time. We recommend to take this tour and ask for Chiara. 👍🏻

Lucia was fantastic. She led our big group seamlessly through the crowd. I was never confused or "lost". She went beyond talking about specific art works but also gave us wonderful insights about general history and culture. The meet up was easy, and all instructions were easy to follow. I appreciate all the email/text reminders as well.

Our flight was delayed the night before we were due to go on this tour and it meant we weren’t going to get to our hotel until 3.30AM…the company had emailed and Whatsapp’d me details of the tour for the following morning. I explain my situation and asked if it was possible to switch days. This was done immediately and without hassle, they just wanted to accommodate us - thank you so much!

The actual tour was brilliant, as mentioned all details are sent the night before so no excuse for not knowing when or where to meet. The tour was very informative and detailed without being ‘too much’. Very well organised and enjoyable. Would recommend this tour.

Thanks again for helping us and for the great tour.

Giuliano was my guide and he was clearly a professional. Friendly, informative, happy to answer questions. This was a fabulous tour, hitting all the highlights of the Vatican within 2.5-3 hours and include skip the line tickets (as the names states) which is a MUST if you don’t want to wait hours in line to enter the Vatican museums and St. Peter’s Basilica.
Would absolutely recommend this tour to family and friends.

Our tour guide Guiliano was so great! Informative and fun. It’s was just the right amount of time to take in all the sights and receive details and background. The sights and information was one of the highlights to our trip to Rome. Well worth it!

We were very pleased with our Vatican tour. There are so many tours online to choose from, it was almost overwhelming. We chose this one because of the reviews. We are so glad we did. Our guide, Marco, was a wonderful guide. He was very personable, funny, and so informative. He has a great skill at being able to tell us so much information without it feeling like a school lecture. He was always ready to answer our questions, and very engaging in conversation. We couldnt have been happier with out tour!

So glad to see St. Peter’s Basilica. Wish we could have spent more time in there it felt a little rushed but other than that the whole tour was amazing! Our tour guide was so fun and knowledgeable. You will not regret this tour!

Our tour of the Vatican was absolutely incredible! Marco was so passionate about each part of the tour, and we couldn't have asked for a better tour guide. We went on this tour during our honeymoon to Rome, and it is something we will always remember.
Highly recommend!

We thought the meeting place quite hard to find but luckily came across a man called Puma who kindly took us to the office...Julian was our guide & was fantastic (I’ve never seen anyone walk backwards up & down steps so good !) his knowledge was superb. We all learnt so much, remaining engaged throughout the whole tour.
Would wholeheartedly endorse this company for the Vatican City tour.

An essential tour for anyone visiting Rome. The Basilica is especially mind blowing and the skip the line and guided tour is so worth it for everyone. Absolutely recommend and very friendly and knowledgeable staff.

Good tour, still some waiting getting from a to b and getting set up on headphones etc. Good overview of the both. I was totally overwhelmed my st peters basilica, wouldn't have spotted all the detail shown to us.

This was a wonderful tour, the best! I was wheelchair bound due to a fall just hours before landing in Rome. The nine flight created a situation I had not planned for! But lemons into lemonade being the idea for as much of my trip as possible…..I called the tour operator who immediately got back with for an easy solution so that I was accommodated during the tour. All the staff were wonderful, thoughtful, polite! Hands down, the best tour company for the Vatican Museums! Highly recommend!

I really enjoyed this tour of Vatican, the guide Giuliano, was prepared and very friendly. He asked many questions and managed well when we had a technical issue with the headsets provided. The tour itself is lovely, so much to see!

Good tour and nice knowledgeable tour guide Giuliano. Would definitely recommend. Note that there is ots of walking and standing - note for less able-bodied people. Would have been better to meet at the gates rather than the Tour Office I feel.
Very impressive tour - not to be missed.

There is alot of walking, however it is so worth seeing. I went with a tour group from our cruise ship. I got sick but was so glad my husband was able to go and share all the beautiful pictures with me. I felt I too was there.

Norman was our guide and he was splendid! We had such a great time with him. Very knowledgeable fellow and funny. Couldn't imagine trying to see this stuff without a guide and this company did a great job. Definitely recommend

I highly recommend. All the tour guides are super friendly and really give great detail. Everything is explained so well. You also get the chance at the end to stay and wander around yourself. But the guides give you a great in depth look into all the things you would want to see in the Vatican.

This tour does not disappoint! If you're like me, reading up on a bunch of history can be very dry. Having a knowledgeable guide to educate was so wonderful. Marco kept the tour moving along and shared a lot of fascinating information. This was definitely a highlight of our first trip to Italy! Pro tip: shoulders and knees must be covered to enter St. Peter's Basilica and the Sistine Chapel, wear a wide-brimmed hat to protect from the sun, and bring water.

Wonderful and insightful tour given by Lucia.She was so thorough providing a details that one would not have received if just done on their own. Tour was well organized and is definitely worth the money. Bring your walking shoes.

I believe Marco was the name of our tour guide. He has great! He had such passion for the history. It was an amazing tour. The only bad thing was the it ended. It flew by. The crowds weren’t that but it was still busy. Highly highly recommend!

Our tour guide, Chiara, was outstanding. Her depth of knowledge and her ability to weave the stories into the tour were fascinating and riveting. She was exceptional and her excellent grasp of several languages added to the quality of the tour. A+

Great explanation about what we were looking at. We went on our own years ago and we were just looking at thing not knowing what we were looking at. Our guide was very knowledgeable. Skip the line tour kept our precious time to a minimum.

Wonderful and competent guide. Went with (adult) family. Can recommend it to anyone. We strolled through the experience at the right pace. At times I felt like it was too fast, however, after the experience I really appreciate these decisions on my behalf given the size of the Vatican.

Giuliano is a dedicated guide with pure passion for what he does.
He knew how to keep everyone's attention and he told very fascinating details.
He takes good care of the entire group.
He even brought us to a taxi because we otherwise would have missed the next tour in the colloseum.
Thank you very much Giuliano!

After checking in we were quickly briefed by Giuliano on the Sistine chapel due to the inability to speak in the actual chapel. His knowledge of not only every bit of the tour but how to beat the crowds and get the best viewing spots was outstanding. We learnt so much and for someone who hates crowds, Giuliano made me so engrossed that I forgot about them. An outstanding guide and a highly recommended way to see the highlights of the Vatican.

Wow, what can I say, amazing tour, knowledgable guide, cares passionately about the place and his guests. Juliano (hope thats how you spell it) looked after us from the moment we met outside the tour office, introduced himself to every member of the group (and it was a big group, with multinational members) took us for an introduction to the Sistine Chapel, as when you are in there it is silence. Walked us through the streets, bit of a walk, but we didn't lose anyone, to the line for the museum tour, we literally skipped the line and were escorted in past everyone. Given headphones and packs so we could hear everything. The museum is extremely busy and you have to keep moving, but that didn’t distract from the information we got. Through the Gardens, museum and onto the Sistine Chapel, where, despite it saying silence, the guards made the most noise!! On out to the steps of the Basilica, where we could see the queues which were at least three hours long, just to get into the Basilica!! Here is where we left Juliano having had a very memorable journey.
These tours are a must if you want to see the museum and St Peters, you couldn’t queue for hours, knowing that for a reasonable amount you can get in, get knowledge and have a wonderful time. Try to get Juliono as he is extremely passionate about the history. FIVE STARS

Our guide was very knowledgeable and entertaining and we didn’t have to queue at all, a definite bonus. He gave us lots of information but it would have been nice to spend more time in the museum. The Vatican tour itself was very informative and the information given at the very beginning of the tour about The Sistine Chapel was good as there was meant to be silence in the chapel - this however was extremely busy with lots of tours going on and certainly not silent. Our guide pressed the need for silence but it was a shame other groups didn’t abide by it. The chapel was breathtaking and definitely worth a visit - as was St Peter’s Basilica. We were disappointed that the tour only took us to The Basilica and though we were given very brief information outside it was difficult to comprehend most of what was there - it would have been better for the tour to continue inside. Having said that, I would definitely recommend this tour as it was informative, entertaining and definitely skipped the queues.

We arrived at the office to be greeted by very friendly and helpful staff who checked us in. Julian showed us pictures of what to expect and told some of the history of the Vatican etc.He was both interesting and entertaining and made the whole visit fun and informative.

I really want to congratulate both the tour operator and particularly Giuliano, our tour guide. We had been to St. Peter’s Basilica before but this was our first time in the Sistine Chapel and Vatican Museums. Having a tour guide to take his time and explain all the details was a great plus and Giuliano knows his stuff! Also, don’t even mention not having to do the long lines. Well worth it.

After searching for a guided tour of the Vatican we eventually booked this one , we are so glad we did , it was well worth the money ,
We didn’t queue at all and our guide Giuliano was absolutely fantastic, very knowledgeable, always making sure everyone was ok and wouldn’t move on until the whole group was together . If you have never been to the Vatican I would strongly recommend you book this tour , you won’t regret it !

We have been to Rome before, and we've seen the Sisten Chapel, the Vatican, and St. peter's Basilica before. But this was my father in laws first time and we wanted to make sure he got the most out of it as possible. So we booked the skip the line tour, and we are so glad we did. The tour guide was great. It is a long tour, but then there is a lot to see, and the guide kept our attention throughout the entire three hours. He was knowledgeable, engaging, and fun. And the skip the line part is a huge perk. The lines are always so long, and if you are traveling in the summer months, it's hot. It even rained while we were walking to the Vatican so standing out there would not have been enjoyable. But our tour guide made it so. I highly recommend you book this tour! It is well worth it and you wont be disappointed
My 18-Year-old son and I thoroughly enjoyed our tour with Giuliano. He was extremely knowledgeable and personable. We would highly recommend his tours.

The tour guide was excellent and did her job well. The tour was all encompassing of the Vatican including the main areas which included the Museum, Sistine Chapel & St Peters Basilica. You should not miss this tour.

I can thoroughly recommend this tour, our guide Giuliano was brilliant, he was extremely knowledgeable and enthusiastic throughout, which made the whole tour a fantastic experience. The group was relatively small consisting of eight people, some of the other groups I saw were very large. You are given a headset so that you can hear the guide. The tour lasted over 3 hours but time went very quickly. If you want to skip the long queues then I highly recommend using this company, it was the highlight of our trip to Rome - thank you Giuliano.

Today we did an excellent tour of The Vatican, including The Sistine Chapel and The Vatican Museum. It was one of the few tours which included the ticket prices for not only these two places but also St.Peter’s Basilica which was my favourite part and a must-do. We didn’t wait for any of the buildings, even security was quick and easy.
Our tour guide Guiliano was happy and enthusiastic, with good English and extensive knowledge.
After the tour we had plenty of time to ourselves to look around, and we paid €10 to go up into the dome of the Basilica which was amazing (unless you are claustrophobic on narrow staircases).
I recommend taking some snacks as we arrived at 12 and didn’t leave til 4.30!
So much to see, definitely go on this tour to learn and see everything.

Our group was about 20 we had head phones through out the tour and could clearly here our guide Gulian who was an excellent and informative guide there was no waiting in line and I can highly recommend this tour

This is the only way to get in to see the Vatican if you do not want to wait for anything between 2 - 4 hours.
The queas were right around the Vatican square and it was a hot day.

Finding our group was very easy, our guide was knowledgeable and personable. Skipping the lines was fantastic. These tour groups have this whole thing down. There are many and all of them are legit. The desk person of our tour company even run after us to return money she thought it had not been included in our reservation, and she brought the extra cash we paid to her back. The Sistine Chapel visit is a rushed shoulder to shoulder river of people visit. But that's the way it is.

We went on this tour today and the tour guide made our day. Giuliano was enthusiastic, humorous, energetic and knowledgeable. He stayed calm in the crowds and knew how to direct a large group of people successfully round the busy museum whilst keeping us informed of the displays were passing at all times. The skip the line is definitely worth it, it avoids queuing for the museum and for St Peter's, saving us hours. Book to go in the afternoon if you can as things are quieter and you can have a bit more space to view the displays and the Sistine chapel itself.
Would definitely recommend and the tour was very much value for money.

Great tour with a lovely guide. Amazed all of the art collections - especially the sistene chapel. Sadly the basilica was closed due to the celebs ration of St Frances and the pope needing to use it to greet visiting dignitaries.

Well worth booking. Guide was excellent, masses of information and passion! It was extremely busy and we gained much by having booked this tour. The time passed quickly and we were surprised by how much time we had spent there.

This really was an excellent tour. Giuliano is an excellent guide. Expert information and fun too.
It was exceptionally busy whilst we were there but he kept everyone together and moving through at a steady pace.
This really is ‘skip the line’ too. We saw large queues for all areas as we walked straight to the entrances.
